system.description: Grants 2-5 objects the power of movement under control of the balladeer. Each object can weigh no more than 200 lb. and moves up to 10' a second.

Causes 1 non-sapient plant or animal to become sapient. Treat plants as the skill Awaken Plant and animals as the spell Endow Intelligence at 2 Aura per Class Title of the balladeer. This effect has a 1% chance of permanence after the ballad is ended.
Morale (and Control Resistance to Fear) is raised by 5% per Class Title of the balladeer for all friendly listeners.

All listeners must make a Control Resistance or follow the requests of the balladeer. Those requests that could cause injury or death allow a further Control Resistance. If any Control Resistance is made, then the effects of the ballad are broken for that listener.

All the dead buried within sight of the balladeer arise as zombies or skeletons depending on their condition. As long as the ballad continues with this power as its focus they will follow the direction of the balladeer. At the end of this effect they fall where they are. There is a 1% chance per zombie and skeleton of the effect remaining permanent. Those that are permanent will be hostile to all life.
When this power goes into effect the balladeer can see a pale glow around those enemies who hear their song.
All listeners are healed 1d4 points per Class Title of the balladeer in up to one wounded area per Class Title. The areas healed can vary from listener to listener.

Creates an illusion of one type (sight, sound, smell, taste or touch.) Every ten seconds, another illusion type may be added. For purposes of damage or ill effect these illusions are considered to be at 2 Aura per Class Title of the balladeer.
All listeners must make a Control Resistance or suffer the insanity of the balladeer's choice for the duration of the ballad.
All enemy listeners take 1d4 damage per Class Title of the balladeer to one area of the balladeer's choice.
Morale is lowered by 5% per Class Title of the balladeer for one hour per Class Title of the balladeer. This applies to all enemy listeners.

All spells and invocations are nullified (temporarily if they are permanent). While this section of the Ballad contiunes no new spells or invocations can be cast or invoked. This has no effect on magical or divine magical skills, powers, potions, songs, poems, etc.

Requires a roll on the Ballad Chaos Table. Each listener must make a Control Resistance or be required to perform the actions (from the table) until the actions are complete or the until ballad or ection of ballad end. If this section of the ballad continues, those beings who made their Control Resistance must make a new one every 10 second, or suffer the chaos effect.
One tear, rip, sunder or break in a structure or large object is repaired, filled in, made good as new, etc..
One structure or large object will be broken open allowing access for an average sized humanoid. Magical structures or objects are unaffected.
All magical animals who hear the ballad are allowed a new Control Resistance to break free of any spell, invocation, poem, song or ballad by which they are currently controlled.

All magical animals of one named type who hear the song and fail a Control Resistance will come to the balladeer and follow any requests the balladeer wishes for as long as the ballad is played. If a request will cause harm to the animal or magical animal, the creature  gets a new Control Resistance. If the Balladeer attempts to entrance an animal who has been tamed by the skill Tame Animal, then the Ballad Lore practitioner must win a contest of skills with the Tame Animal practitioner to entrance the animal.

A sense of peace overcomes all animals and magical animals who hear the song, and they will cease all hostile action and will initiate no new hostile actions while the ballad is played. If attacked, animals and magical animals are allowed a new Control Resistance to fight back.

All magical plants of one named type who hear the song and fail a Control Resistance will follow any requests the balladeer wishes for as long as the ballad is played. If the request will cause harm to the magical plant, the magical plant gets a new Control Resistance.
One listener per Practitioner Title is immune to all Banshee Wails and Banshee Howls for the duration of the ballad.
Compulsion for blood is suppressed for 1 being within listening range for the duration of the ballad.

The skin and muscles of 1 listener of the balladeer's choosing rapidly decomposes, inflicting 2d4 damage per second to 1d4 random body areas for the duration of the ballad. The victim is allowed a Magic Resistance for each second of damage.
One listener per Practitioner Title is protected from the fetid bite of any ghoul, including physical, poison and disease effects, for the duration of the ballad.

One listener per Practitioner Title gains an illusion of death for the duration of the ballad. Each listener smells, looks, feels, sounds and even tastes like the dead. The listener is allowed a Control Resistance if unwilling or unknowing.

One natural, magical or undead tree or plant of the balladeer's choosing within 5' per Practitioner Title quickly begins to rot, inflicting 1d6 damage per second for the duration of the ballad. The target is allowed a Magic Resistance for each second of damage.
One listener per Practitioner Title is protected from Touch effects of undead shades and wraiths (excluding dragons) for the duration of the ballad.
Causes 1 volcano within sight to become active and erupt.

Causes up to 5 cubic feet of snow per Class Title, within sight, to loosen and give way. Anyone caught in the resulting avalanche takes 2d6 crushing damage per 5 cubic feet and has a chance of being completely embedded in snow resulting in the inability to breathe, as well as hypothermia within 40 minutes and 1d4 cold damage to head and limbs per hour.

Causes 1 listener per 2 Class Titles to make a Control Resistance or believe all statements spoken by another as fact for the duration of the ballad. Once the ballad ceases, the targeted listener(s) may make an Intelligence save to review the aforementioned statements and decide if it was indeed truth or not. To switch beliefs after the ballad has ended, the targeted listener(s) must make a Will Force save.

Causes existing plants and ground formations in an area up to 2 cubic feet per Class Title to reform into any shape desired by the balladeer, as long as they are within 10' from a non-magical fire. This ballad does not affect trees taller than 5', stone, or magically created plants and ground formations.

Allows the balladeer and 1 listener per Class Title to see normally through burning flames. All non-magical flames appear transparent in the targets' line of vision for the duration of the ballad. This ballad does not allow lava to be seen through.

Causes up to 10 cubic feet of ice and slush to melt at a rate of 1 cubic foot per Practitioner Title every 5 minutes. This ballad can affect both magical and non-magical ice within a range of 10' per Practitioner Title. This ballad has no effect on snow or water.

Gives all listeners an extreme sense of happiness and bliss; all sorrow, anger and fear are swept away, and a Will Force save must be made to take any detrimental or offensive action. Those unwilling or unknowing are granted a Control Resistance. This joy lasts an additional 2d6 minutes per Class Title after the ballad has ended.

The singer can either transfer one specified memory of an event that transpired no more than 5 years ago per Practitioner Title from the target to themselves, or from themselves to the target (who is allowed a Control Resistance). This particular memory exchanges minds for 1d4 minutes per Class Title, and there is a 5% chance per Practitioner title the memory will be permanently transferred. The memory can be as specific as a wedding day, slaying someone with a sword for the first time, or falling off a horse as a child; it can be as vague as living in a particular area for many years, wearing a well-worm suit of armor, or enduring many years of reading by candlelight. The receiver of the memory also gains a vague sense of emotions felt while experiencing the event and details like names and places associated with the memory. This ballad cannot be used to transfer skills, powers, abilities, etc.

This ballad works while accompanying the telling of a myth or legend with music and refrain. Upon hearing a myth, legend or otherwise bold statement doubted by more than 75% of any given area's population, the practitioner is given a sense of whether the myth or legend is true or false as stated. This does not grant the practitioner extra information of what actually is true; it only defines that which is not.

Creates a lush, pleasant oasis with a radius of 10' per Practitioner Title from only a single drop of water and 1 berry or slice of fruit. After the first 10 minutes of the ballad's performance, the ambient temperature is altered to 78 degrees Fahrenheit. After another 10 minutes, the targeted drop of water expands into a plentiful source of pure water fed by a never-ending underground spring. After the final 10 minutes, the targeted berry grows into a garden of lush, edible plants. Since this is a magical area, it cannot be otherwise magically or divinely affected by affects such as Blessed Ground, Enchant Area, and etc. This oasis exists only for the duration of the ballad: once the practitioner ceases, all magically created effects instantly fade away, leaving only the original drop of water and berry.
Causes up to 1 cubic foot of non-magical rock per Class Title to loosen (and fall, if applicable) in an area within 10' per Class Title.

Grants all friendly listeners a +5% bonus per Class Title to the skills Balance, Boat Wright, Cartography, Climb, Danger Knowledge, Direction Knowledge, Ferrier, Heavy Drinking, Navigate, Rope Use, Rowing, Sail and Sing Songs as long as they are on some sort of water vessel.

Allows the balladeer to speak to and understand an object or area of solid stone no larger than 5 cubic feet per Practitioner Title. The balladeer speaks to the stone using the ballad's lyrics, and then pauses (while continuing to play) to listen to the stone's response.
Allows all listeners to understand each other's speech, no matter what language they are using, for the duration of the ballad.
Allows the balladeer and 1 listener per Class Title to walk on water as if on solid ground for the duration of the ballad. No ripples or other signs of passing are left behind.

Creates up to one dream object per current title of the balladeer. Each item can be no more than 10 lb. per title of the balladeer. There is a 5% chance that the items will be temporarily magical at up to +1 per 3 full titles of the balladeer. This ballad only works on the plane of dreams. One designated item has a 2% chance per title of the balladeer of returning with the dreamer when leaving the dream plane.

Creates a gateway up to 20 feet high and 10 feet wide that can open to one plane connected to this plane per 3 titles of the balladeer. The place the portal is connected to may also be elsewhere on the same plane. Each connecting point is described by the practitioner based on a place they have seen or had described to them (Knowledge save required for each.) The gateway appears in whatever form the practitioner desires, a door, a mirror, an archway, etc. Some form of attunement device has to be present on (or near) the gateway to allow it to be set to the particular point if there is more than one. Also, anyone passing through gateway gains 1 appropriate protection effect for the plane they are travelling to that lasts as long as they stay on that plane. The gateway itself lasts 1 day per title of the balladeer and is permanent if 1 Will Force is expended.

Creates a place of safety that is up to 10 cubic feet or 10 feet in diameter (practitioner's choice.) The place of safety provides the following effects: contains a pocket of breathable (replenishing air), temperature is kept to 72 degrees Fahrenheit, pressure is kept to sea level of earth, there is a replenishing source of water (pool, pond or fountain), the pH balance of all liquids within the area becomes neutral. The area is also surrounded by a thin barrier which keeps out all negative magical effects. A form of desired food appears on one of the surfaces that will feed up to 10 beings per practitioner title and reappears three times per day. There is also a walkable surface created as needed out of whatever normal material desired with a lip at the edge high enough to prevent unintended falls. This place of safety lasts 1 day per title of the balladeer and is permanent if 1 Will Force is expended.
Removes up to one negative effect caused by a supernatural being per title of the balladeer on any number of beings within sight.

Causes 1 Angel under 10th level per balladeer's title or Celestial Incarnate under 10th title per balladeer's title to make a Magic Resistance at -20% or forget the balladeer, any allies present, and any tasks related to them when the ballad is sung. They must also make a Control Resistance at -20% or leave the area immediately.

Causes 1 Devil under 10th level per balladeer's title or Infernal Incarnate under 10th title per balladeer's title to make a Magic Resistance at -20% or forget the balladeer, any allies present, and any tasks related to them when the ballad is sung. They must also make a Control Resistance at -20% or leave the area immediately.

Makes 1 dragon sorrowful and contemplative, lulling them to sleep if they are on the ground or fly away if they are in the air. The dragon must make both a Magic Resistance at -20% and a Control Resistance at -20% and failing either leave if in the air, or fall asleep if on the ground.

Causes 1 Neutral Supernatural being under 10th level per balladeer's title or Deva Incarnate under 10th title per balladeer's title to make a Magic Resistance at -20% or forget the balladeer, any allies present, and any tasks related to them when the ballad is sung. They must also make a Control Resistance at -20% or leave the area immediately.
Causes a rift in a love union (unless both make Will Force save).
Makes one suggestion to a single visualized individual. If harmful, a Control Resistance is needed to escape the suggestion.
Causes favorable reaction from one individual unless a Will Force save is made.
Causes one opponent to make a Control Resistance or suffer -1 to all physical attributes for one full day.
Gives a +1 Vitality for one day. New resist for poison and disease if either is in effect and a +20% to both resistances thereafter for one day.

Gives 3 luck points to any individual visualized including self. Each point must be used individually. A luck point gives a +1 or +5% modifier to any roll, modifying it up or down to the lucky being's advantage.
Gives +10 to current Aura Pool, +2 to Aura Control and +10% to Magic Resistance for one day.
Removes the current control effects from one individual and gives +30% to Control Resistance rolls for one day.
Undead haunting an area make Control Resistance or remain peaceful.
Allows user to scry on one individual as the spell Scrying for up to one hour.
User gets vision of the nearest hidden treasure and is able to sense where it lies.
Causes 1 named being to be immune to all cold effects for 12 hours.
Causes 1 named being to be immune to all fire effects for 12 hours.
Causes 1 named being to be immune to all electrical effects for 12 hours.
Causes 1 named being to be immune to all acid effects for 12 hours.
Send 1 message of up to 1 word per Practitioner Title that is relayed in that being's next dream.

The practitioner performs this ritual and binds one animal familiar to themselves. The effects are identical to the spell Bind Familiar, with the exception that no Will Force is given up, and that the familiar must be a creature of type animal. A Candle Lore practitioner may only have one animal familiar at a time.

The practitoner performs an hour long ritual on a piece of wood and when the ritual is complete, this piece of wood will point to the nearest source of water when held and asked to find water. The stick retains this power for one day.
The practitioner can find the location of one specific known and named animal.
The practitioner can sense all animals of one type in a named area. For example, the practitioner could choose to sense all wolves in the Black Forest.
The flames from the candles emit a magical light, enlarging current shadows within a 50' radius by 25% of their original size.
Causes the practitioner to be immune to paralysis, hold, sleep, and draining effects of lesser undead beings (under level 4).

Creates an overpowering stench of death and decay in a 5' radius per Practitioner Title. Any being with smell as a natural sense must make a Vitality save or be turned away from the area. Beings with enhanced smell or the skill Smell must make an additional Vitality save at half to avoid vomiting and losing 1d6+1 seconds of action.
The smoke of the candles envelope and cling to the user, creating a superficial disguise of their life force. Anyone actively Life Sensing will have a 50% chance to see past the disguise.
The flames from the candles emit a magical light, reducing the size of shadows within a 50' radius by 50% of their original size.

Protects 1 being per Practitioner Title against physical attacks, targeted spells, invocations, and effects originating from lesser and minor undead. This ritual does not offer protection from greater and arch undead (level 9+).
The smoke from the candles encircles the ritualist and the target, temporarily providing relief from the effects of non-terminal diseases for the duration of the candles.
The smoke from the candles encircles the ritualist and the target, temporarily providing relief from the effects of non-terminal poisons for the duration of the candles.
Causes 1 named being to be immune to the effects of breathing in smoke, sulfur, and brimstone. All toxic air is treated as normal, breathable air.
Causes all waves within 50' per Practitioner Title to decrease in size by 10% per Practitioner Title.
Provides protection from extreme temperatures to 1 named being by negating all adverse affects such as heat exhaustion or hypothermia.
Protects 1 named being from extreme heat, preventing heat exhaustion and sunburn, and allows the target to survive without water for 1 day with no adverse effects.
Protects 1 being per Practitioner Title against physical attacks, targeted spells, invocations, and effects originating from Elementals.
When performed on a water vessel, provides a bonus of 10% per Practitioner Title to the skills Balance, Boat Wright, Cartography, Ferrier, Navigate, Rope Use, Rowing, and Sail to 1 named being.
Allows the practitioner to sense all elementals of one type in a named area. For example, the practitioner could choose to sense all Fire Elementals in the Tower of Flames.

The smoke from the candles hangs like a fog in a radius of 10' per Practitioner Title, hiding all individuals and items within. Unlike normal smoke, however, this magical fog is safe to breathe and carries no odor.
Causes any portal or gateway used within 1 day per practitioner title to reopen and stay open for up to 10 minutes per practitioner title.
Allows up to one supernatural being per practitioner title to return to their home plane in a place that they imagine as home or that is known and provides them with safety.

Supernatural being is targeted by the practitioner and at the end of the hour long ritual that supernatural makes a Control Resistance. Failure indicates the supernatural being is bound to a specific task until they either complete that task or 1 day per practitioner title has passed.

Circle is drawn, and then the practitioner summons a spirit image of a supernatural being seen within 1 day per practitioner title. The summoned being sees and hears the practitioner and the area around the summoning circle. It can speak but is not compelled to do so. Separate control effects used on the spirit can only be used to make it speak, and/or tell the truth. All other effects do not work on the being. The spirit image will remain for 1 minute per practitioner title. The spirit image is a copy of the mind and spirit of the supernatural being, not the true being.

The practitioner summons the floating spirit bust of someone they can visualize within 10 miles per practitioner title. That bust cannot move but it can see and hear and speak to the practitioner and anyone within range. It is a projection of the real being but no effects other than control used to make it speak, and/or tell the truth can be used. The bust lasts for 1 minute per practitioner title.

Creates a return point in the center of the ritual candles. 1 time, after the ritual ends (even after the candles burn out) the practitioner and up to 1 additional ally touching the practitioner per class title, can instantly return to the ritual location.
Causes the nearest Angel under 10th level on the same plane to make a Control Resistance or be summoned to the circle of candles and held there until the candles gutter out.
Causes the nearest Devil under 10th level on the same plane to make a Control Resistance or be summoned to the circle of candles and held there until the candles gutter out.
Causes 1 named being to be immune to all negative Aura, and Chaos effects for 12 hours.
Causes 1 named being to be immune to all negative darkness, and death effects for 12 hours.
Causes 1 named being to be immune to all negative light, and life effects for 12 hours.
Heals 1d4 per Practitioner Title to one body area. The practitioner suffers one level of fatigue for each 10 points healed.
Causes the focus to have a positive reaction to a being of the skill user's choice unless a Will Force save is successful for the focus.
Grants 4 luck points to the focus. Each point can be used to alter a die roll by +/- 1/5% in favor of the focus. Only 1 point can be used at a time. Luck lasts 1 day.
Allows the practitioner to transfer the use of 1 magical skill, power or spell to the focus for 1 full day, during which time the skill user cannot use the ability.
Causes the focus to be +5% to Magic, Illusion and Control Resistances for one full day.
Allows the user to transfer one attribute point per 2 Practitioner Titles from any attribute of the practitioner to the focus being. Points transfer back in 24 hours.
The next monetary transaction completed by the focus will go in favor of the focus, generating more money. Transaction must be within one day of ritual.
One Message of up to one word per Practitioner Title is relayed in that being's next dream.

The victim temporarily gets younger by 1/10 of their lifespan per Practitioner Title. Attribute effects change based on age (see Aging Effects). Youthful lasts 1 hour per Practitioner Title, upon which the being returns to their normal age.

The practitioner performs this ritual and binds one magical animal familiar to themselves. The effects are identical to the spell Bind Familiar, with the exception that no Will Force is given up. The familiar must be a creature of type animal or magical animal. An Empathy Magic practitioner may only have one animal familiar and one magical animal familiar at a time (allowing for two familiars).

The practitioner performs a ritual and binds one magical plant to themselves. The effects are identical to the spell Symbiosis, with the exception that no Will force is given up, and that the plant must be a creature of type magical plant. An Empathy Magic practitioner may only have one plant bond at any time.

The practitioner imagines a tree or plant of their choosing, and after a ritual is performed, the practitioner can sense life from through that plant as the skill Life Sense.  If a face has previously been carved into the tree, or one has been shaped into the tree with the skill Wood Lore, then the practitioner can see, hear and smell from the face on the tree as well.

The practitoner performs a brief ritual and then literally melds into a tree or plant larger than the practitioner's body.  The practitioner can stay in this form for one hour, and all possessions stay with the being when the meld occurs.  The being can sense life from within the plant identical to the skill Life Sense.

Creates an alignment colored barrier around the ritualist, protecting them from evil-aligned divine magical spells, skills, weapons, etc. This lasts 1 day per Practitioner Title and remains in effect for the full amount of time, even after the ritualist is deceased.

Creates a seal around a crypt or tomb, disallowing admittance of any being from any Plane for 1 day per Practitioner Title. This ritual may be counteracted by the Sympathy Magic Ritual Crack Crypt by using a contest of Will Force, modified by Practitioner Titles and Will Force differences (+/-5% per).
Uses the evil deity's symbol to block a single being from contacting their evil deity for the use of any invocations or skills, including Commune, for a period of 24 hours.
Grants the focus an acute mental alertness, providing +5% per Practitioner Title to Perception and Concentration rolls.
Grants dexterity to the focus, offering a +5% per Practitioner Title to Agility saves.
Causes the focus to temporarily recall a single forgotten memory of an event that transpired no more than 4 years ago per Practitioner Title.
Causes the focus to scrutinize all new information both perceived and given, offering a second chance to perform any action, even if the first was a Critical Failure.
Causes wings to sprout from the focus's back, granting normal flight. This ritual has no effect on beings who already have natural wings.
Grants a bonus of +5% (per 3 full practitioner titles) to all Disease Resistance rolls for the ritualist and one ally per practitioner title. This effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title.

Swap minds with another being. Mental contact occurs during the ritual and if the target consents at the end of the ritual then ritualist or one designated (who must also consent). Swaps minds with the target. The effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title or permanently if 1 Will Force is spent by either of the involved parties (both must still consent).
Grants a bonus of +5% (per 3 full practitioner titles) to all Magic Resistance rolls for the ritualist and one ally per practitioner title. This effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title.

Allows the practitioner to see all supernatural spirits, recently dead beings (ghosts), etc. Even if the spirit doesn't normally have a form (an outline or orb of aura) is created based on the alignment of the being as the spell Reveal Aura. This effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title.
Grants a bonus of +5% (per 3 full practitioner titles) to all Illusion Resistance rolls for the ritualist and one ally per practitioner title. This effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title.
Grants a bonus of +5% (per 3 full practitioner titles) to all Poison Resistance rolls for the ritualist and one ally per practitioner title. This effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title.
Grants a bonus of +5% (per 3 full practitioner titles) to all Control Resistance rolls for the ritualist and one ally per practitioner title. This effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title.

Calls to the nearest Angel on the same plane (under 10th level). The Angel may make a CR to resist (if desired). There is a 1% chance an Archon comes instead. The Archon is likely to be upset unless the cause is especially just or important. If the Angel is not on a current task, they may come without resisting (GM's discretion). Once present it will make itself known to practitioner. At that time the practitioner can make a request. If the request is a noble or a just one the Angel will grant it if it is within their power to help.
The paper with the name is burned. Causes one focus being to be unable to speak negatively about a person or group without a successful a Will Force save per attempt. Lasts 1 day.

Requires the burial place or the body of the spirit (if they died to become a spirit) or any anchoring object that the spirit prizes or prized while alive. Spirit (and the attached soul) is forced to move on to the proper plane based on their type. Good beings go to the heavenly planes, evil to the hellish and neutral or unaligned to purgatory. Spirits or spirit beings from other planes are afforded a Control Resistance at -20%. Failure indicates they are banished to that plane.

Requires an object handled by an evil invocation user. This object and the particular evil invoker are then focused on by the ritual performer who must have good as part of their alignment or worship a good deity. If the ritual skill roll is successful the evil invoker focused on is unable to use any invocations for the remainder of the day.

Links the practitioner and up to 2 others per class title. The practitioner and allies exchange small tokens with each other. When the ritual is complete, they can all sense the direction of any other in the fellowship and approximate distance. This ritual lasts until the specified goal or quest is completed.
Ghosts will lose their special requirements to be near where they died or near a specific item. They are then drawn temporarily to the ritualist for 1 hour per class title.
Sanctifies an area to life and the living. Undead must make a Control Resistance to enter the specified area. Lasts for 1 day.

1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Inscribed on a piece of armor, the object becomes magical and gives a defensive adjustment of +1 per 5 Class Titles. In addition, it grants one point of Force Armor (as the spell) per Class Title.

1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Inscribed on a weapon, the object becomes magical and gains +2 to hit and +2 to damage per 5 Class Titles.

1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Planeshift (takes one minute of focused concentration). Gains minimum powers necessary to survive on that plane without environmental ill effects.

1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: True Flight (as spell). Jump (as spell). Relocation (as spell, takes one minute of focused concentration to teleport).

1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Blink (as spell). Grants +10 speed seconds. Grants -1 initiative and -2 defense adjustment per 3 class titles of inscriber. Grants +1 Agility per 3 class titles of inscriber. Grants +1 Intelligence per 3 class titles of inscriber.

1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Grants +1 Vitality per 3 class titles of inscriber. Grants +5 Endurance per 3 class titles of inscriber. Regeneration: 1d4 Endurance healed per minute; lost limbs may be regrown this way.

1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Weapon gains +1 magical bonus per 2 class titles of inscriber. Weapon gains +1 extra die of damage per 2 class titles of inscriber.

1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Engraved within the area of a single necropolis, catacombs, cemetery, or other tomb complex, the glyph will prevent any of the dead buried there from rising as or being raised as undead of any kind; any lingering souls will be sent on to the afterlife. Any undead that enter or are otherwise caught in the area with a level equal to or lower than the class title of the inscriber will be destroyed immediately; undead of higher level than the inscriber of the glyph may enter the area, but may not use any innate powers or abilities.

1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Engraved on the central keep of a fortress, this glyph doubles the structural strength of all structures of the fortress. Furthermore, any food or water stored inside the fortress will not spoil and are cleared of any contaminants.

1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Grants +1 Appearance per 3 class titles of inscriber. Grants +1 Charm per 3 class titles of inscriber. Wearer is always clean and presentable and smells faintly of perfume. Glyph is designed to be incorporated as part of another artistic tattoo; viewer must succeed at a Glyph skill roll or a quarter Rune Lore skill roll to recognize the glyph.

1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: True Flight (as spell). Endure Electricity (as spell). Healing (1d4+1 per titles, as the invocation, once per minute).

1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Blink (as spell). Endure Cold (as spell). Greater Regeneration (Greater Regeneration: Heals 1d4 points per 10 seconds to all wounded areas including vitals. Cannot regenerate from fire, or acid damage, or if the head is separated from the heart.

1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Teleport (as spell). Endure Fire (as spell). Distortion (as the spell).

Raises the Affinity of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity by 2% per Practitioner Title. Additional Affinity gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1% per hour, beginning 1 hour after the hymn ends.

Raises the Agility rating by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to supersede racial maximum) of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity. Additional Agility points gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.

Permanently dispels one previous invocation or hymn in effect, or temporarily dispels all the divine powers of one item within 2' per Practitioner Title of the hymnist (not including curses). When attempting to dispel invocations or hymn effects, a contest is rolled between the Piety Control of the singer dispelling and the being who created the divine effect. Permanent effects are at a +75% versus this Hymn.

Causes the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to become insubstantial, leaving their bodies behind and traveling as spirits. They can travel as far and as fast as they are capable of imagining in any direction. The personalities and minds of the spirit travelers remain with the spirits, and their bodies become empty shells during this time. While in this state, the hymnist's body continues to physically sing the hymn (through the deity's or deity's servant's control), and their spirit can command their body to cease singing at any time, during which all spirits return and the effects of the hymn end. The spirit travelers are not capable of casting spells or interacting physically with the world while in spirit form. The spirit travelers can only be detected by those who have Life Sensing, Telepathy, or Thought Projection and who notice the mental presence of the spirit travelers (determined by a Will Force save). Once the hymn ends, all spirits are wrenched back into their bodies. If a spirit travelers' body is killed, they becomes a New Ghost.

Raises Intelligence by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to supersede racial maximum) of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity. Additional Intelligence points gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.

Creates a barrier of divine force that surrounds the bodies of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity, on top of any armor or clothing. This divine armor provides 1 point of armor protection for each Practitioner Title and lasts for 5 minutes per Practitioner Title. This effect counts as Spiritual Armor for stacking rules.

Provides a sign given by the hymnist's deity to be used to determine if the choice under question is advisable or not. The GM determines if any appropriate sign is possible and then causes something representing the answer (either yes or no) to happen. It is then up to the listeners to interpret the sign. No more than one sign about a particular choice in question will be granted within a 24-hour period (GM discretion).

Lowers the Affinity of all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity by 2% per Practitioner Title. Affinity rating points lost in this manner return at a rate of 1% per hour, beginning 1 hour after the hymn ends.

Cleanses one object or area within sight no larger than 1 square foot per Practitioner Title of all disease, dust, grime, scum and bacteria. When used against slime or earth-based beings, 1d4 magical damage per Practitioner Title is applied to a single random location. If the slime or earth-based creature is supernatural, then there is a 1% chance per Practitioner Title of banishing the creature to its home plane.

Grants the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity an additional +2% per Practitioner Title to Commune Chance and an additional +5% per Practitioner Title to the skills Divination and Omen for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title.

Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or instantly and utterly renounce their own faith and convert to the particular deity of the hymnist. This affect is permanent and can only be reversed with a new Renunciation or Conversion hymn sung by a follower of the listener's previous deity, or a successful Convert skill roll.

Causes the hymnist and all listeners who either reside currently, or have resided in the past, in the particular land or nation named in the hymn, to be filled with an overwhelming sense of animosity and humiliation for that particular homeland for 1 hour, gaining +5% to Control Resistance, +1 to hit, and -1 defense adjustment (all per 2 Practitioner Titles) while harming anyone or anything that originates from or speaks for that particular homeland. A Control Resistance is necessary for any listeners who do not wish these effects.

Causes winds of erosion to gust violently against one structure or altar dedicated to the worship of a deity other than the hymnist's. For the duration of the hymn, the structure miraculously is eroded and degraded until it remains just a pile of splinters and rubble. The Will Force rating of the hymnist is permanently reduced by one.

Causes one object or structure no larger than 5 cubic feet per Practitioner Title to shatter, melt, burn, or otherwise be permanently destroyed, in whichever fashion deemed appropriate by the hymnist's deity. The deity must approve of the object being destroyed; if the hymn targets something which the deity does not wish to destroy, nothing will happen. The target object must be within visual range, including through scrying. Once destroyed, the object cannot be magically repaired. Magical and divine magical items receive a Magic Resistance, but this hymn has no effect on artifacts or living beings.

Permanently restores one Will Force point lost within 1 day per Practitioner Title of the hymnist, for either the hymnist or 1 listener who follows the hymnist's deity, as long as they make a Piety save upon hearing the music of the hymn. This hymn cannot be used to restore Will Force which was voluntarily given up.

Allows the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to identify the divine magical powers, abilities, and usages of one particular divine item by seeing a glow of light around the being or item appropriate to the deity from which the divine magic came and visual indicators of the powers and effects.
Grants a +5% bonus per 2 Practitioner Titles to all Discipline skills for the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity for 1 hour.

Causes one being, object, or area no larger than 50 cubic feet per Practitioner Title to disintegrate into nothing but dust. The deity must approve of the target being destroyed; if the hymn targets something which the deity does not wish to destroy, nothing will happen. The target object must be within visual range, including through scrying, even if it lies on another plane. Magical and divine magical items and structures/building materials, as well as living beings, receive a Magic Resistance.
Grants a +5% bonus per 2 Practitioner Titles to all Divine Magical skills for the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity for 1 hour.

Grants the skill Theology specifically in regard to the hymnist's deity at a chance of 5% per Practitioner Title to the hymnist and all listeners who follow the deity of the hymnist. Any listeners who already have the skill gain a second skill chance rather than adding this chance to their first skill. This bonus lasts for 1 minute.

Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or doubt the entire doctrine of their own faith, resulting in a temporary loss of 2 Piety per Practitioner Title and a -5% per Practitioner Title to all saves/resistances against the hymn Renunciation or the skill Convert. This doubt lasts for 2d4 weeks, after which the listener loses all doubt and instantly regains the lost Piety points.

Decreases divine protection for all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity, inflicting +1 defense adjustment per Practitioner Title and -2% to all resistances per Practitioner Title. Lasts for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title.

Raises the Endurance of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity by 2 points per Practitioner Title. Additional Endurance points gained in this manner fade at a rate of 2 per hour, beginning 1 hour after the hymn ends. Damage effects that would kill or maim someone with reduced Endurance go into effect immediately when lost Endurance would cause the effect, including new vitality saves, etc.

Raises Knowledge by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to supersede racial maximum) of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity. Additional Knowledge points gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.
Grants a +5% bonus per 2 Practitioner Titles to all Informational skills for the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity for 1 hour.

Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity to gain a sudden overwhelming fear of that deity's power and status, unless a Control Resistance is made at -2% per Practitioner Title. For the following hour, affected listeners obey all commands spoken in that deity's name, are +1 Piety and -1 Will Force per 2 Practitioner Titles of the hymnist, and must make a modified Will Force save every 10 minutes or fall down in prostration and worship the hymnist's deity for 10d6 seconds, ignoring all other actions. This hymn has no effect on beings immune to fear.

Raises Vitality by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to supersede racial maximum) of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity. Additional Knowledge points gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.

Instills great faith within the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity, granting a bonus of +2% per Practitioner Title to all resistances against the skills Convert, Convince, Fear, Intimidation, Insanity, Possession, and Wounding, a modifier of +5% per Practitioner Title for anyone attempting the skills Cure Disease, Cure Insanity, Cure Poison, Exorcism, Healing, Remove Fear, Resurrection, and Sooth, and a bonus of +1 Piety Control per 2 Practitioner Titles. Maximum Piety Control that can be gained is +6. These effects fade 1d4 hours after the hymn ends.

Raises the Fortune of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity by 2% per Practitioner Title. Additional Fortune gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1% per hour, beginning 1 hour after the hymn ends.

Causes the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or scrutinize 1 friend or ally per Practitioner Title named in the hymn, contemplating that friend's imperfections and recognizing any ugly, sinful qualities (thus allowing listeners to recognize lies or deceitful actions the friend never mentioned). All affected listeners feel obligated to act judgmentally, attempting to instigate violence by any means possible. All affected listeners must make a Will Force save to abstain from any hostile action. These urges fade 5 minutes per Practitioner Title after the hymn ends, but the listeners still retain all new information gained about their ally.

Permanently reduces the Will Force rating by 1 for 1 listener who does not follow the hymnist's deity, as long as they fail a Piety save upon hearing the music of the hymn. This effect can only be used once by a practitioner against any specific target (although the target may be affected by multiple practitioners).
Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or be immobile for 10 seconds per Practitioner Title.

Allows the hymnist and 1 listener per Practitioner Title who follows the hymnist's deity to read the history of an item or living being within physicalcontact by gaining a mental feeling or picture of all positive and negative things that happened around the item or being for the past 1 week per Practitioner Title. Items and beings protected with Non-Detection are immune to the effects of this hymn, as are artifacts, and unwilling targets are allowed a Magic Resistance.

Imbues a musical instrument with the effects of one hymn currently known by the hymnist. The power of the hymn can be activated by playing one note or chord by anyone with the skill Hymn Lore who follows the same deity. One hymn can be imbued per 2 Practitioner Titles. Each hymn imbued causes a permanent loss of half a Will Force point and requires an additional Hymn Lore skill roll at -20% while the instrument is being imbued. Activation time for the hymn is 1d4+1 seconds, which is set at the time of imbuement. The power is always activated at the Class Title of the player using the skill Hymn Lore. Although the skill Hymn Lore requires hymns to be sung in order to have effect, the Hymn of Imbuement allows an instrument to create the effects of any hymn without the hymnist having to sing the words.

Raises Wisdom by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to supersede racial maximum) of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity. Additional Wisdom points gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.

Causes all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel compelled to visit the nearest temple or worshiping place of that deity, if there is one within 5 miles per Practitioner Title. The affected listeners will use any means necessary to make their way to the temple for the next 30 minutes per Will Force of the listener. If there is no temple within range, the listeners feel compelled to cease all current activities and construct an altar of worship within the next 1 minute per Will Force. Once the listeners reach a temple or constructs an altar, they must spend at least 1 minute per Piety worshiping their deity. For the following week, every time the listeners come within sight of a temple or altar of that deity, they must make a Will Force save or visit the temple and worship for another 1 minute per Piety. Those who cannot complete their goal within the allotted time must make a Will Force save or gain an Insanity of obsession over visiting temples of that particular deity (any time they hear of a temple in the area or see one, they must go to it and worship, and they must make another Will Force save to leave).

Grants the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity +1 per Practitioner Title to Piety Control and halves the prayer time required for invocations. Maximum Piety Control that can be gained is +6. This effect lasts for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.

Causes all listeners (regardless of deity) to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or uncontrollably laugh in ecstasy over the hymn's subject of joy, resulting in -1 to Intelligence and Wisdom, +1 to Appearance and Charm, -20% to all Concentration checks, and +20% to Morale checks. Each listener laughs for 1d4 minutes after the hymn ends.
Slows weapon speed by 1 second per 3 Practitioner Titles for all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity for 6d10 seconds.

Projects an image of the hymnist's deity in any shape and form that deity desires, visible by all listeners within 10' per Practitioner Title. The listeners who follow that deity gain +2 Piety while viewing the manifestation and may communicate with it at a +2% bonus per Practitioner Title to Commune. The manifestation remains for 1d4 minutes. Since this is only a representation of the deity and not the actual deity, it is impervious to damage and can appear anywhere, in any environment. The deity may also choose not to manifest itself at that time, at the GM's discretion.

Causes 1 willing listener who follows the hymnist's deity to lose all defensive actions and resistances against hostile attacks. If death occurs within 1 hour per Practitioner Title, the martyr's spirit and soul instantly move on to the plane of that deity, and the body is immune to any undead conversions. Also, all witnesses of the martyr's death who follow that deity temporarily gain +5% Morale per Practitioner Title as well as +1 Will Force and +1 Piety per 2 Practitioner Titles. All hostile witnesses are -5% Morale per Practitioner Title and must make a Will Force save at -5% per 2 Practitioner Titles to attempt any hostile action toward anyone who follows the deity of the hymnist. These effects last for 1 day per Will Force of the martyr.

Causes all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance (if desired) at -2% per Practitioner Title or settle into a calm state of mind, focusing thoughts and removing anxiety, providing the following effects: A new Control Resistance towards any current controllingfactors; a +10% Control Resistance for 1 hour. +1 to hit and damage for 1 hour. Current fatigue effects are reduced by half. Fatigue effects for the next hour happen twice as slowly (1 minute of fatigue is applied per 2 actual minutes). Any temporary lost attribute points are restored at a rate of 2 per hour. While each listener is completely at rest, temporarily lost attribute points return at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes. Each listener counts as having one Will Force rating point higher when defending against a hostile spell or effect which depends on Will Force, such as mental combat, Hold, Possession, etc.

Lowers the Fortune of all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity by 2% per Practitioner Title. Fortune lost in this manner returns at a rate of 1% per hour, beginning 1 hour after the hymn ends.

Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title (if desired) or uncontrollably weep in grief over the hymn's subject of loss, resulting in a -1 to Intelligence, Wisdom, Appearance, and Charm, and a -20% to all Concentration and Morale checks. Each listener weeps for 1d4 minutes after the hymn ends.

Causes all listeners who either reside currently, or have resided in the past, in the particular land or nation named in the hymn to be filled with a bursting sense of nationalistic pride for 1 hour, gaining +5% to Control Resistance, +1 to hit, and -1 defense adjustment (all per 2 Practitioner Titles) while defending that particular homeland's people or their freedom from invading forces.
Lowers the Perception of all hostile listners by 2% per Practitioner Title. Perception lost in this manner returns at a rate of 1% per hour, beginning 1 hour after the hymn ends.
Raises the Perception of all friendly listners by 2% per Practitioner Title. Perception gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1% per hour, beginning 1 hour after the hymn ends.

Raises Piety by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to supersede racial maximum) of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity. Additional Piety points gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.

Causes all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity and 1 listener per Practitioner Title who follows another deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title (if desired) or feel an overwhelming sense of awe and praise toward the hymnist's deity, causing all divine effects both targeting and originating from the listener to increase by 10% per Practitioner Title (including range and duration).

Allows the hymnist to look into the future of the being, place, or event named in the hymn and see the most probable outcome. This event is viewed as a mental picture with sound. There is no guarantee that the event will actually happen, only that it is the most likely future depending on current events. The prophesied event will usually be no more than 1 day per Practitioner Title into the future, but the Game Master may allow for a longer time based on great events to come. This hymn may be attempted only once per day. Note (GM discretion).

Causes all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title (if desired) or perform any necessary actions to placate that deity's revealed anger over a previous action committed by the listener. Once the deity's anger has been revealed (either directly or indirectly), a sign is given, either physically or mentally, showing each listener what must be done in order to placate that deity. Each listener will continue all attempts to follow through until the deed is completed and the deity reveals to each listener their individual propitiation. This hymn also affects ghosts and undead who worshiped that deity while living, even if they have the immunity Control (Lesser), as long as they have magical hearing.

Provides divine protection for the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity, granting -1 defense adjustment per 2 Practitioner Titles and +5% to all resistances per 2 Practitioner Titles.
Removes all salt, suspended impurities, bacteria, viruses, and toxins from all food and water within 5' per Practitioner Title.

Creates a semi-transparent shimmering sphere in a color of the hymnist's deity's choosing which prohibits magical and divine magical weapons, items, skills, spells, and invocations from passing through in either direction by instantly dispelling them. Supernatural beings of level 5 or less are returned to their plane of origin or are destroyed (in the case of lesser undead) when they touch the sphere. This effect is treated as the invocation Sphere of Protection at a Piety Control of the Practitioner's Title x2.

Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or instantly and utterly renounce their own faith, with a 1% chance per Practitioner Title of converting to the particular deity of the hymnist. This affect is permanent and can only be reversed with a new Renunciation hymn sung by a follower of the listener's previous deity or a successful Convert skill roll. If no new faith is adopted, the listener is now considered either Agnostic or Atheist and loses the ability to perform any divine magical skills.

Causes the soul of one being for whom the requiem is written to be immune to all transformations to undead and creates an immediate summoning of a portal through which that soul may enter the plane of its deity in the afterlife, if it had not already. The target must have worshiped the hymnist's deity and been dead less than 1 day per Will Force of the target soul.

Causes winds of divine magic to blow firmly amidst the ruins of one structure or altar dedicated to the worship of the hymnist's deity. As the hymn is sung, a shimmering surrounds the rubble and splinters and divinely reconstitutes the temple or altar to its former glory, filling in areas even if material is missing. The Will Force rating for the hymnist is permanently reduced by one. No furnishings save an alter or focus of worship are fixed or replaced (a door counts as part of the temple and is restored, but a door lock counts as a fixture and is not).

Allows the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to detect supernatural beings, evil, good, life force, and divine magic within 5' per Practitioner Title of the hymnist. The power of these forces and direction are felt by each listener. Once each source is detected, each listener can sense their movement and location for as long as they remain within range. Each listener can detect only the beings initially detected, and any new beings that enter the vicinity (within range) are not detected.

Grants the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity a +5% bonus per Practitioner Title to each listener's next single application of any skill that requires a ritual to perform, such as Ritual Lore, Sacred Grove, Empathy Magic, etc.
Instantly removes all fatigue from the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity.

Creates a divine magical shield controllable by the hymnist that can be placed between two objects or beings. The shield acts as a barrier and stops attacks between the two if the hymnist makes a Piety save. However, all magical and divine magical weapons and effects pass through the shield. The Hymn of Shielding cannot block more than one blow per second unless two or more blows are simultaneously aimed for the same area. In such cases, only a single Piety save is required to block the blows. The shield only stops 100 points of damage; any amount over 100 will damage the area below the shield. The shield can be used to protect any object or being within a 2' diameter and lasts for 10 seconds per Practitioner Title.
Grants a +5% bonus per 2 Practitioner Titles to all Stealth/Intrusive skills for the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity for 1 hour.

Raises Strength by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to supersede racial maximum) of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity. Additional Strength points gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.

Causes all hostile listeners to make a Magic Resistance or choke, losing 1d6 overall Endurance per 10 seconds. At the onset of asphyxiation, a Will Force save must be made to remain calm or damage is doubled. When Endurance has been reduced to 0, the target appears very pale and must make a Vitality save every 5 seconds to remain conscious (-5% to the save for every point below 0). Once Endurance reaches the target's negative Vitality rating, the lungs have collapsed and the heart stops beating. One minute later, if Endurance is not raised above the negative Vitality rating, the target dies. A Chirugeon roll will resuscitate the suffocated target and raise overall Endurance to 1 point above negative Vitality. Should the target survive the ordeal, restoration of Endurance is based on healing rate, with minutes instead of days and a period of 10 minute intervals instead of weeks.

Grants all listening invokers who follow the hymnist's deity the ability to instantly gain one invocation no higher in Piety Control than 3 per Practitioner Title without having to spend the necessary prayer time, since the hymnist supplicates on behalf of the invokers.

Causes all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to lose all need for food and water and instead rely solely on divine, spiritual sustenance for 1 day per Practitioner Title, during which the listener feels neither hunger nor thirst and takes no damage or negative effects from lack of food and water. Those unwilling are afforded a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title.

Lowers the Will Force rating of all hostile listeners by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles, unless a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title is made. Will Force lost in this manner return at a rate of 1 per hour after the hymn ends.

Temporarily transforms the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity into 1 type of object approved by the deity, no larger than 5 cubic feet per Practitioner Title. A Magic Resistance avoids this transformation if desired. While transformed, each listener appears as the object but retains each individual life force. One sense (hearing, sight, touch, smell, or taste) per 2 Practitioner Titles may be retained while transformed. This transformation begins as soon as the hymn ends, takes 1d4 seconds to complete, and lasts for 1 minute per Practitioner Title. If the deity does not approve of the listeners transforming into the type of object stated in the hymn, that deity may choose to either transform them into something else instead or do nothing. Also, each effected being can spend 1 Will Force permanently to stay transformed indefinitely. Dispel Divinity, Restore Form, Wish, or Miracle then would be required to restore a being to normal form.
Grants a +5% bonus per 2 Practitioner Titles to all Combat skills for the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity for 1 hour.
Quickens weapon speed by 1 second per 3 Practitioner Titles, not to go below minimum weapon speed, for the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity for 6d10 seconds.
Grants Enhanced Night Vision to all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.
Grants Exceptional Eyesight to all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.
Grants Far Sight to all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.
Grants Infravision to all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.
Grants Ultravision to all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.

Causes 1 listener per Practitioner Title to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel enthusiastic devotion and tireless diligence toward one specific being, location, object, or idea stated in the hymn, negating all indifferent feelings and canceling any preconceived plans to act accordingly. All affected listeners must make a modified Will Force save to avoid performing any action that would prove their new zeal toward the stated target. This feeling of zeal lasts for 30 minutes per Practitioner Title.

Causes the sins of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to be absolved by that deity, permanently removing all negative alignment checks. Furthermore, any undead within 5' per Practitioner Title who worshiped the hymnist's deity while living have a 10% chance per Practitioner Title of being destroyed and if souled moving on to the plane of that deity.

Causes 1 listener per Practitioner Title who does not follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel a sense of total selflessness and genuine concern for the welfare of others (regardless of their alignment), resulting in a Will Force save at -5% per Practitioner Title to perform any action that would in any way be considered selfish or greedy (at the GM's discretion). This feeling of altruism lasts for 1 minute per Practitioner Title.

Increases the Appearance and Charm of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles while speaking about that deity or performing a skill in that deity's name, such as Bless, Convert, Exorcism, Hymn Lore, etc. This effect lasts for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title.

Causes all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel the sudden urge to apologize to 1d4 people against whom the listener caused a grievance within the past 1 day per Practitioner Title. The affected listener will perform any necessary actions (without going against alignment) to communicate with that person, no matter the cost, and will not rest until the apology has been made, no matter how long it takes.

Causes all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity and 1 listener per Practitioner Title who follows another deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or scrutinize 1 enemy per Practitioner Title named in the hymn, viewing that enemy's inner beauty and recognizing any redeeming qualities. All affected listeners feel obligated to act mercifully, attempting to avoid violence by any means possible. All hostile actions must be superseded with a Will Force save. These urges fade 5 minutes per Practitioner Title after the hymn ends.
Bestows a blessing upon the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity, granting +1 to hit and +5% to all resistance rolls per 3 Practitioner Titles, lasting 1 hour.

Summons or dismisses a Good-aligned supernatural servant by name (the hymnist must know the true name of the servant to summon or dismiss), either of which cannot be resisted by the servant. When summoning, control is automatically granted to the hymnist if the deity wishes it, unless the supernatural servant is immune to control. When dismissing, the servant must remain within earshot of the hymnist during the entire 10 minutes of the hymn.
Removes all physical and emotional pain, hunger, and thirst from the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity for 1d4 minutes.

Causes 1 listener per Practitioner Title to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel obligated to confess the truth about anything about which they had previously lied during any point in their life. While under affect, the listener must answer all questions truthfully but will not mention any other lies until brought up by someone else. The listener will confess only to the hymnist, and this obligation ends after 1 minute per Practitioner Title.

Instills in all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity a sense of courage, gaining the following positive effects for 1 hour per Practitioner Title: +1 damage per die to melee and missile weapons in combat, +2 to hit with melee and missile weapons in combat, -2 initiative in combat, +5% to Control Resistance per 3 Practitioner Titles of the hymnist, Affected beings can go Berserk if they so desire at 5% chance per 3 Practitioner Titles of the hymnist, +10% to morale checks.

Allows the hymnist to create divine magical goods. The hymnist imagines the desired item and then makes their Hymn Lore skill roll. If successful, it begins as an illusion in the air of the item to be created, adding to it with note and chord, word and refrain. When the hymn is complete, the item becomes real and is considered to be +1 divine magical per 3 Practitioner Titles with a base 2 Piety Control per Class Title of the hymnist. Items created last 1 hour per practitioner title. Combining this hymn with a social skill that produces goods affords -10 to the social skill rating and thus a +50% modifier to the skill roll for producing quality goods. Will force cost for permanent items is 1/10th of a Will Force. Only one permanent item can be created per week.

Allows the hymnist to create divine magical goods. The hymnist imagines the desired item and then makes their Hymn Lore skill roll. If successful, it begins as an illusion in the air of the item to be created, adding to it with note and chord, word and refrain. When the hymn is complete, the item becomes real and is considered to be +1 divine magical per 3 Practitioner Titles with a base 2 Piety Control per Class Title of the hymnist. Items created last 1 hour per practitioner title. Combining this hymn with a social skill that produces goods affords -10 to the social skill rating and thus a +50% modifier to the skill roll for producing quality goods. Will force cost for permanent items is 1/10th of a Will Force. Only one permanent item can be created per week.

Allows the hymnist to create divine magical goods. The hymnist imagines the desired item and then makes their Hymn Lore skill roll. If successful, it begins as an illusion in the air of the item to be created, adding to it with note and chord, word and refrain. When the hymn is complete, the item becomes real and is considered to be +1 divine magical per 3 Practitioner Titles with a base 2 Piety Control per Class Title of the hymnist. Items created last 1 hour per practitioner title. Combining this hymn with a social skill that produces goods affords -10 to the social skill rating and thus a +50% modifier to the skill roll for producing quality goods. Will force cost for permanent items is 1/10th of a Will Force. Only one permanent item can be created per week.

Allows the hymnist to create divine magical goods. The hymnist imagines the desired item and then makes their Hymn Lore skill roll. If successful, it begins as an illusion in the air of the item to be created, adding to it with note and chord, word and refrain. When the hymn is complete, the item becomes real and is considered to be +1 divine magical per 3 Practitioner Titles with a base 2 Piety Control per Class Title of the hymnist. Items created last 1 hour per practitioner title. Combining this hymn with a social skill that produces goods affords -10 to the social skill rating and thus a +50% modifier to the skill roll for producing quality goods. Will force cost for permanent items is 1/10th of a Will Force. Only one permanent item can be created per week.

Grants a +5% per Practitioner Title bonus to 1 listener who follows a Neutral Good to Good-aligned deity to the following list for 1 hour. Skills: Call of the Light, Control Supernatural (vs. undead and ghosts), Destroy Undead, Detect Curse (when involving undead and ghosts), Exorcism, Influence the Dead, Life Sense, Life Strike, Mask Life Force, Protection from Supernatural, Remove Curse (when involving undead and ghosts), Still Life Force, Suppress Undead Compulsion, Turn Undead, Undead Lore. Candle Lore rituals: Coexist with Undead, Mask Life Force, Protection from Undead. Ritual Lore rituals: Disguise Life Force, Epitaph, Negative Life Vapor, Preservation, Release Soul, Remove Shadow, Reveal Life Force. Poems: Soothe Undead, Undead Fire Protection, Undead Poison Protection. Songs: Calm Undead, Frozen Bones, Incorruption, Undead Chill Protection, Undead Disease Protection. Ballads: Banshee Resolve, Blood of the Vampire, Ghoul's Bite, Shadow's Touch. Runes: Day, Disguise Life Force, Gravestone, Life, Natural Sunlight, Protection from Undead, Righteousness, Turn Undead.

Causes all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to feel a close bonding with each other, gaining a total of +2% per Practitioner Title when collectively attempting to Commune with their deity. The affected listeners also gain +30% to morale and +5% per Practitioner Title to all skills performed on each other (such as Cure Poison, Bless, Mind Dance, etc.).

Causes all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or forgive all personal debts or grudges previously held. This ends all desires for revenge or animosity, resulting in a -20% per Practitioner Title to Will Force rolls in collecting debts or taking hostile actions against anyone the listener has forgiven. Note: If the listener is a Revenant who worshiped the hymnist's deity while living, they no longer is affected by the disability Compulsion: Task and falls lifeless to the ground, no longer an undead creature, but just a mundane corpse.

Glorifies the hymnist's deity, resulting in a gain of 1 point of Fortune per Practitioner Title (as per the invocation) for the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity, +5% per 2 Practitioner Titles to all divine magical skills, and +5% Control Resistance per 2 Practitioner Titles against any ill effects originating from a being who does not follow that deity. These effects last for 1 hour. In addition, the glorified deity may choose to intervene or additionally aid its followers in some way (at the GM's discretion).

Grants a +2% per Practitioner Title bonus to Poison and Disease Resistances for 1 hour to all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity and instantly heals 1d4+1 per Practitioner Title to the most wounded area of each affected listener.

Causes the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or lose all sense of pride and instead be filled with humility and meekness, resulting in +1 Charm and +1 Piety per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to exceed racial maximum), as well as the need to make a Will Force save at -5% per Practitioner Title to perform any action that would be considered prideful or boastful (at the GM's discretion). This would include showing off a skill to others or taking undeserved credit.

Causes all non-living souls (i.e. ghosts and souled undead) within 5' per Practitioner Title to be instantly judged by their particular deities as either deserving or undeserving of moving on to the planes of those deities, whether good, neutral, or evil. Whether or not the deity decides to allow the affected souls to move on is completely at the GM's discretion and must be based on both the particular values and ideals of the deity and the actions committed by the souls. If a deity decides the soul is unworthy of moving on and finding peace, that soul remains in its current state and may not be judged again by this hymn, no matter the practitioner.

Causes all non-magical and non-divine locks and bindings (including rope, cuffs, etc.) to open within 1' per Practitioner Title of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity who are currently being held or imprisoned unjustly (such as for committing a crime they did not commit or preaching on behalf of their deity).

Creates a divine magical bright sphere of light with a radius of 3' per Will Force of the hymnist no further than 5' away per Will Force point. The sphere can either be centered on a moveable object or being or be fixed in one place. The illumination radius for normal sight is 5' per Piety rating of the hymnist. The light is a soft, slowly intensifying light which lasts 15 minutes per Practitioner Title. Only one globe per Practitioner Title may be active.

Causes all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or avoid all actions, beings, and places considered immoral or evil in any way for 1 hour.

Causes all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or become extremely loyal to a particular cause or being, resulting in a -5% per Practitioner Title to Will Force saves when attempting to go against anything which furthers that cause or is requested by that being, and will attempt to defend the cause or being at all costs. Furthermore, all affected listeners gain +20% to morale whenever within the vicinity of the being or acting for the good of that being or cause. Effects last 1 day per Practitioner title.

Creates a sphere of true day, even at night, brightened with natural sunlight. All beings within the sphere are affected as if it were day. All effects which are dependent upon sunlight or daytime apply, regardless of the actual time. Thus, within the sphere of the Hymn of Noontide, a Lesser Vampire who is normally active at night will be immobilized and burn from sunlight as if it were actually exposed to the sun. The sphere, which has a radius of 10' per Practitioner Title, is centered on a fixed location (up to 2' per Practitioner Title from the hymnist) when created and cannot be moved, and it lasts for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title. The hymns of Twilight and Midnight will override the Hymn of Noontide if the latter hymnist makes their Hymn Lore roll by more than the previous hymnist.

Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or temporarily cease all hostile actions against each other, including derogatory words and offensive attacks. This hymn does not affect thoughts or emotions but rather provides control over each listener's physical actions arising from those thoughts or emotions. Furthermore, those who fall under the hymn's affect will also attempt to convince those still unaffected to cease hostile actions. For every 10 seconds the hymn continues, all listeners who have not yet succumbed to peace must make a new Control Resistance with a penalty of an additional cumulative -5%. The hymn cannot last more than 10 minutes total, and once the hymn is over, the temporary peace instantly and abruptly ends.

Raises the Will Force saves of all listeners by 5% per 2 Practitioner Titles when being tempted to take any action that would be considered evil, resulting in possible alignment checks. This effect lasts for 2 hours after the hymn ends.

Instantly purges 1 named poison, disease, type of insanity, or possession per Practitioner Title from all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity, as long as they make a Piety save upon hearing the music of the hymn. This hymn has no effect on curses or lycanthropy.
Instantly cures all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity of lycanthropy, as long as the listeners make a Piety save upon hearing the music of the hymn.

Heals any one existing body area with less than 1 Endurance to exactly 1 Endurance, affecting the hymnist and 1 listener per Practitioner Title who follows the hymnist's deity. All missing limbs of the affected listeners are instantaneously regenerated at the cost of 1 Will Force per limb restored. The Will Force cost is permanently paid by either the target or the hymnist. Vital areas that have been severed will not be regenerated. Multiple sub-areas regenerated (such as several fingers on the same hand) count as one limb.

Causes the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to sincerely repent of all previously committed sins since their last act of repentance.
