All affected listeners gain +1 Piety per 2 Practitioner Titles, 2 Fortune points per Practitioner Title, and +5% Control Resistance per 2 Practitioner Titles against any Evil aligned hymn or invocation that affects one's actions, such as the Hymn of Temptation or the invocation Aggression. These effects last for 1 hour. Furthermore, upon repenting of any actions that resulted in negative Alignment checks, the deity may decide to remove those Alignment checks (at the GM's discretion).

Restores life to one recently deceased being who, in life, worshiped the hymnist's deity, as long as the deceased target's ghost makes a Piety save upon hearing the music of the hymn. Once the soul is returned to the body, one Will Force is permanently drained from the recipient. Furthermore, all bodily damage is removed, but any missing limbs remain missing. The body is in a weakened state, with all attributes drained to one. One attribute point for each attribute will be restored for each hour of complete rest. This hymn may be attempted on a deceased individual only once, regardless of the number of hymnists available to perform the hymn. Each hymnist is limited in use of this hymn to a number of times each day equal to their Class Title.

Invokes salvation for the hymnist and all listeners who either follow that deity or an allied deity from all hostile or potentially fatal beings, places, or events by intervening and miraculously removing that danger in whichever way that deity chooses. For example, if the hymn is being sung while a fatal avalanche is heading down a mountain slope toward the hymnist, the deity may choose to either halt the avalanche or remove the hymnist from the slope; or, if a band of goblins has ambushed the hymnist's party of adventurers and is injuring them with arrows, the deity may choose to strike the goblins dead or cause the arrows to reflect off the adventurers and return back to the goblins. The means of salvation is completely at the GM's discretion. However, if the GM decides that the hymnist does not warrant salvation or that removing the danger does not fit into the deity's predestined plan, nothing happens. This hymn may only be sung once per month, and any further attempts or attempts during non-desperate situations may invoke the anger and wrath of that particular deity, resulting in divine denial.

Causes all listeners who follow an Evil or Neutral-Evil deity to make a Control Resistance or become morally sanctified for the duration, resulting in desires to serve, help, heal others, and serve the cause of good. The normally belligerent and violent being would become friendly and peaceful, in all except the most extreme of circumstances. Thirty minutes per Practitioner Title after the hymn ends, each affected listener reverts back to their previous alignment and loses all memory of events that transpired while transformed.

Creates a divine magical sphere of intensely glowing light no further away than 2' per Will Force point. The sphere is centered on a fixed location and will not move from the location where it is created. The light is so bright that it blinds beings and creatures with night vision (non-enhanced), even the hymnist, if applicable. All negative life force beings within a radius of 10' per Practitioner Title are temporarily drained of 1 Will Force point per 10 seconds if they fail a Control Resistance in that 10 second period. The globe lasts 15 minutes per Practitioner Title, and only one globe may be active at a time.

Causes all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or follow all commands given by the hymnist, as long as those commands do not go against the morals and commands of that deity, for 1 minute per Practitioner Title.

Endows all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity with an overwhelming thankfulness toward that particular deity for every fortune bestowed within the past 2 months per Practitioner Title, gaining +2 Piety and Wisdom and +15% to Morale. The listener must also make a Will Force save at -5% per 2 Practitioner Titles before attempting the skills Begging, Cheat, Gambling, Harlotry, Lie, Steal, or Torturing. Lasts 1 hour per Practitioner title.
Temporarily removes all effects of Xenophobia from the hymnist and all listeners for 1 hour.

Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or speak only the truth and be completely unable to lie in any way for 1d4 minutes. Affected beings can choose to remain silent.
Causes the hymnist and all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or be unable to say or do anything that would be considered immoral or evil for 1 hour.

Grants a +5% per Practitioner Title bonus to the hymnist and all listeners to the following for 1 hour: Skills: Call of Air, Electrokinesis, Levitation, Summon Supernatural (when targeting an Air Elemental). Candle Lore rituals: Death Stench, Endure Electricity, Sense Elemental (when sensing Air Elementals). Ritual Lore rituals: Enhanced Breath, Guide Wind, Weather. Poems: Springing, Weather. Songs: Cloudwalk, Electricity, Flying. Runes: Cloudblend, Warding vs. Air Elemental.
Grants a +5% bonus per 2 Practitioner Titles to the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity when performing the skills Potion Lore, Elixir, Matter Lore, and Transmutation for 1 hour.

Allows either the hymnist or 1 listener who follows the hymnist's deity to summon a spirit of a deceased ancestor. The summoner can either allow the ancestor's spirit to occupy their body and speak through it for a period of 1 minute per Practitioner Title, or they can simply mentally converse with the spirit for the same period. There are no guarantees that the spirit will speak or give the correct answers, but the spirit will not try to forcefully inhabit the body. The spirit can remain in the body no longer than 5 minutes per Practitioner Title.
Allows the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to assume the shape of any type of animal for up to 1 hour per Practitioner Title and return to their natural form when desired.

Causes the hymnist and 1 listener per Practitioner Title to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel indifferent toward one specific being, location, object, or idea stated in the hymn, negating all negative or positive feelings and canceling any preconceived plans to act accordingly. This feeling of indifference, in effect turning the listener's alignment to True Neutral in regards to the target, lasts for 30 minutes per Practitioner Title.

Allows the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to communicate with up to 1 particular tree per Practitioner Title, which become aware of what has happened to and around them, with an intellect with mental attributes rating roughly equal to the hymnist. One of those trees also temporarily gains independent sapience and mobility, gaining the skill Life Sense, a magical voice, and a keen sense of hearing through vibrations. This tree has dim and clouded memories of its previous life as a non-sapient plant. See the skill Awaken Plant for more specific tree characteristics. All of these effects last for 5 minutes per Practitioner Title.

Inflicts 1d4 per 2 Practitioner Titles to Water Elementals to a single random location every 10 seconds unless a Magic Resistance is made. If the elemental has been summoned from another plane, there is a 1% chance per Practitioner Title of banishing the creature to its home plane.
Decreases humidity and increases aridity in the air by 10% per Practitioner Title in an area around the hymnist with a radius of no larger than 10' per Practitioner Title.
Causes all moisture (including sweat) to be removed from a single random location on the epidermal layer of all beings within a radius of 10' per Practitioner Title, resulting in dried skin.

Causes up to 1 gallon per Practitioner Title of non-magical water or water-based liquid to rapidly evaporate. For waterbased liquids, all water is evaporated, leaving a dry residue powder consisting of the ingredients.

Causes the hymnist and all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel a strong sense of generosity (regardless of their alignment), resulting in a Will Force save at -5% per 2 Practitioner Titles to avoid sharing something of value with someone else that as of yet has been solely in possession of the listener's. For example, this hymn would cause a rogue to equally share with their cohorts or friends any coins they found while alone or undetected, whereas normally they would most likely keep their find a secret and horde it for herself. This feeling of benevolence lasts only until the listener has performed a single act of generosity, after which all normal urges return.

Summons or dismisses a Neutral-aligned supernatural servant by name (the hymnist must know the true name of the servant to summon or dismiss), either of which cannot be resisted by the servant. When summoning, control is automatically granted to the hymnist if the deity wishes it, unless the supernatural servant is immune to control. When dismissing, the servant must remain within earshot of the hymnist during the entire 10 minutes of the hymn.

Grants the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity the ability to read images from or project images into the minds of each other, whether they are awake, unconscious, or in a meditative state. Images can be read or projected for 1 minute per Practitioner Title of the hymnist. Those protected by spells or powers like Mind Set are immune to the effects of this hymn. This hymn does not allow for listeners to initiate mental combat.

Grants temporary sapience to one non-magical plant or slime, or an area of stone, sand, earth, or water (no larger than 10 cubic feet per Practitioner Title) touched by the hymnist, causing it to become temporarily and dimly aware and allowing it to remember all that has transpired around it in its lifetime as feelings and impressions. Since these targets have no sight, they cannot give visual images. The target cannot speak but communicates through thoughts and impressions to the hymnist. Lasts 10 minutes per Practitioner Title.

Conjures one neutral-aligned elemental (fire, water, etc.), which is automatically under control of the hymnist. The elemental's type is determined by the hymnist's deity and must emerge from a source of its composition (for instance, a Fire Elemental could appear from a campfire, a Water Elemental from a puddle, etc.). Each elemental remains for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title, after which it dissipates and returns to its home plane. The elemental summoned is the same as the similar invocation type (Summon Water Elemental, etc.) and is considered to be at 2 Piety Control per Practitioner Title.

Grants a +5% per Practitioner Title bonus to the hymnist and all listeners to the following for 1 hour: Skills: Cryokinesis, Crystal Lore (when involving ice). Candle Lore rituals: Endure Cold. Ritual Lore rituals: Snow Storm, Weather (when involving snow, sleet, or cold temperatures). Poems: Frostbite, Snowdrift, Snowwalk, Weather (when involving snow, sleet, or cold temperatures). Songs: Snowmelt, Snowsight, Undead Chill Protection. Ballads: Avalanche, Icemelt. Runes: Freezing, Iceblend, Inner Chill, Inner Warmth.

Causes 1 named body area on all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity to slowly decay as if the body area were dead, requiring a successful Magic Resistance or suffering the loss 1d4 damage per Practitioner Title per 10 seconds.

Causes 1d4 body areas (chosen by the deity) on all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity to quickly decompose as if the body areas were dead, requiring a successful Magic Resistance or suffering 2d6 damage per Practitioner Title per 10 seconds.

Causes 1 non-living object touched by the hymnist to deteriorate as if quickly moving forward through time, resulting in a loss of 1d6 Object Strength per 10 seconds. Magical and divine magical items are afforded a Magic Resistance, but artifacts and living beings are immune to the effects of this hymn.

Causes either one being, animal, plant, or object to decrease in size by 5% per Practitioner Title, with a minimum size of 1%. Unwilling targets are afforded a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title, and magical and divine magical items are afforded a Magic Resistance. The target's size remains diminished for 5 minutes per Practitioner Title, after which it reverts back.

Grants a +5% per Practitioner Title bonus to 1 listener who follows the hymnist's deity to the following for 1 hour: Skills: Animal Lore, Animal Shape, Area Sense, Awaken Forest, Awaken Plant, Botanist, Climatology, Control Growth, Evoke, Falconry, Foraging/Forestry, Gaea Lore, Haunted Grove, Herb Lore, Florist/Horticulturist, Nature's Ground, Nature Lore, Plant Shape, Reincarnation, Sacred Grove, Speak to Animal, Speak to Plant, Summon Animal, Tame Animal, Totem Call, Weather Lore, Wood Lore. Candle Lore rituals: Bind Animal Familiar, Divining Rod, Locate Animal, Sense Animal. Ritual Lore rituals: Bind Magical Animal Familiar, Impervious Forest, Locate Magical Animal, Sense Magical Animal, Guide Wind, Weather, Wedding. Poems: Boughbreak, Compass, Water Finding, Weather. Songs: Animal Entrancement, Electricity, Tranquility, Tree Parting, Weave Plants. Ballads: Awaken, Greater Animal Entrancement, Greater Tranquility, Oasis, Plant Entrancement, Rotting Wood. Runes: Evocation, Natural Sunlight, Strengthen Wood, Wandering.

Causes the earth to tremble and shake, damaging buildings and causing fear and uncertainty to those unfamiliar with its effects, in an area up to 1 mile away per Practitioner Title within sight of the hymnist. The size of the area affected is determined by the hymnist's deity. The first 40 seconds of the earthquake has no measurable effect as the power of the earthquake builds. After the initial buildup, the effects are as follows: Epicenter: structures suffer 10d8 structural damage per 10 seconds of the quake. All non-flying individuals will be thrown to the ground. A 1% chance per Practitioner Title exists that the ground breaks open beneath any enemies who will suffer 10d6 crushing damage per 10 seconds after falling in. After 1 minute of falling into an earthquake fissure, beings will begin to suffocate. Morale checks are required at -50% or GM characters flee in random directions. half mile per Practitioner Title from the epicenter: structures take 8d6 structural damage per 10 seconds of the quake. All individuals must make an Agility save once per 10 seconds or be thrown to the ground. Morale checks are required or GMCs flee in random directions. 1 mile per Practitioner Title from the epicenter: structures take 4d6 structural damage per 10 seconds of the quake. 10 miles per Practitioner Title from the epicenter: tremors from the quake can be felt. 100 miles per Practitioner Title from the epicenter: beings with Depth Knowledge can feel the rumblings of the quake and can determine the approximate direction to the epicenter. Buildings constructed to withstand earthquakes, as well as reinforced buildings of high-quality manufacture, suffer only half damage from the earthquake.

Allows the hymnist or 1 listener who follows the hymnist's deity to transform into a neutral-aligned elemental for 1 minute per Practitioner Title. The type of element into which the being transforms is as if they have cast the corresponding invocation (Elemental Water Form, etc.) at 2 Piety Control per Practitioner Title. The necessary element must be within 1' per Practitioner Title; for instance, if the hymnist wishes to transform into a Water Elemental, they must be within range of water (a puddle, filled water skin, lake, etc.). This hymn does not allow for transforming into life or death elementals.

Grants the ability to evoke the power of an animal to the hymnist and 1 listener per Practitioner Title who follows the hymnist's deity. The deity chooses which animal's characteristic will be evoked for each affected listener, unless that listener already has a totem animal. This transformation, visible or not, takes place after 1 minute and lasts for as long as the hymnist sings. Once the hymn ends, all evocation fades. Only one ability may be evoked during each singing session. Anyone who does not wish to evoke is afforded a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title.

Causes a large area (25' radius per Practitioner Title) to become imbued with positive life energy, providing a tranquil feeling which draws all manner of living things to it. For each hour within the area affected by this hymn, waking beings are healed at their healing rate as if one day has passed, sleeping beings are healed as if one week had passed, disease and poison effects and duration are halved, one Control Resistance may be attempted to initiate combat per 10 seconds (those being attacked do not need to make this resistance to defend), and fertilization chance from sexual intercourse is increased by 5% per 2 Practitioner Titles. These effects last for 4d6 hours after the hymn has ended.

Grants a +5% per Practitioner Title bonus to the hymnist and all listeners to the following for 1 hour: Skills: Call of Earth, Caustokinesis, Excavation, Flint Knapping, Gemology, Geology, Geography, Gravikinesis, Magnetokinesis, Metal Lore, Metal Working, Metallurgy, Mining/Tunneling, Speak to Stone, Stone Lore, Summon Supernatural (when targeting an Earth Elemental). Candle Lore rituals: Endure Acid, Sense Elemental (when sensing Earth Elementals). Ritual Lore rituals: Grave, Resonate Stone. Poems: Shifting Sands. Songs: Burrowing. Ballads: Rockfall, Stonespeak. Runes: Collapse, Sandblend, Stoneblend, Warding vs. Earth Elementals.

Grants the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity a +5% bonus per 2 Practitioner Titles to Control Resistances against Evil-aligned supernatural beings (excluding undead), a +1 Knowledge per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to exceed racial maximum), a +2% per Practitioner Title to Commune, and immunity to Fear, Heat, Cold, Disease, Poison, and Death-based magic. All of these effects last for 1 hour.

Causes either one being, animal, plant, or object to increase in size by 5% per Practitioner Title. Unwilling targets are afforded a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title, and magical and divine magical items are afforded a Magic Resistance. The target's size remains increased for 5 minutes per Practitioner Title, after which it reverts back.
Create up to 1 gallon per Practitioner Title of non-magical water or water-based liquid in a container or area.
Heals 1d4 per 2 Practitioner Titles to Water Elementals to a single damaged location.

Grants a +5% per Practitioner Title bonus to the hymnist and all listeners to the following for 1 hour: Skills: Call of Water, Hydrology, Oceanography, Summon Supernatural (when targeting a Water Elemental), Water Lore. Candle Lore rituals: Calm Sea, Divining Rod, Sense Elemental (when sensing Water Elementals). Ritual Lore rituals: Rain Dance, Snowmelt, Weather (when involving rain, fog, and humidity). Poems: Water Finding, Weather (when involving rain, fog, and humidity). Songs: Calm Waves, Crashing Waves, Snowmelt, Waterspeak. Ballads: Icemelt, Waterwalk. Runes: Freezing, Melting, Warding vs. Water Elementals, Waterblend, Wavebreaker.
Increases humidity and decrease aridity in the air by 10% per Practitioner Title in an area around the hymnist with a radius of no larger than 10' per Practitioner Title.
Causes the epidermal layer of all beings within a radius of 10' per Practitioner Title to be instantly moisturized.

Causes an area or object within a 5' radius per Practitioner Title and no larger in size than 3 cubic feet per Practitioner Title to seem to disappear as if it did not exist. This is only an illusion, however, and may be countered with an Illusion Resistance. This hymn causes objects to remain unseen for 1 minute per Practitioner Title. Movement of the affected object or area (i.e. leaves of a tree rustling in the breeze) immediately breaks this effect.

Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or drift toward a Passive Neutral alignment, viewing things in 'convenient' terms and avoiding confrontation and any actions that would be considered either purely good or purely evil. If confronted with combat, all affected listeners will attempt to flee or otherwise secure themselves. No Good or Evil-aligned spells, invocations, or skills may be performed (such as the invocations Aggression or Heal, the spell Call Undead, or the skills Bless and Blasphemy). These effects last for 1 hour.

Grants the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity the ability to detect all supernatural beings and sources of divinity, visible or invisible, within 10' per Practitioner Title, as well as a +2% per Practitioner Title to Commune chance for 1 hour.

Allows the hymnist and  all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to communicate through mental images with the nature around them, including trees and plants, animals, water, earth, stone, and air, by entering a meditative and primal, bestial state. Affected listeners also gain the ability to understand nature's forces, its ecosystems, weather patterns, migrations, eruptions, etc. While in effect, all mental and social attributes of each listener are reduced to 4, and listeners are incapable of reacting to speech and body language of non-animal or plant living beings, excluding each other. By entering this primal state, each listener can communicate with nature through touch (in the case of the physical elements, such as stone and wood), mind (in the case of mentally contacting animals), and breathing (in the case of air). After 1 minute per Practitioner Title, each listener rises from this primal state and attributes are returned to normal, but they retain all memory of feelings, actions, and imagery which occurred while under the effects of the hymn.

Permanently neutralizes any acid or base substance and removes all beneficial or ill effects from intoxicants, non-magical herbs, and alcohol. When targeting an acid or base substance, both salt and ionizing materials are extracted. All targeted substances must be within the hymnist's aura field while the hymn is being sung, meaning they must either be in direct contact with the substance or with a container holding the substance.

Prohibits the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity from being magically healed or wounded through use of skills, spells, invocations, or herbs, as well as any magical regeneration or degeneration of limbs, for a total of 1d4 minutes per Practitioner Title. Effects that cause damage by introducing a magical energy (Finger of Fire, Storm of Daggers, etc.) still work normally.

Grants a +5% per Practitioner Title bonus to the hymnist and all listeners to the following for 1 hour: Skills: Call of Flame, Fire Making, Pyrotechnics, Pyrokinesis, Summon Supernatural (when targeting a Fire Elemental). Candle Lore rituals: Brimstone, Endure Fire, Sense Elemental (when sensing Fire Elementals), Smokescreen. Ritual Lore rituals: Weather (when involving hot temperatures or aridity). Poems: Fire, Undead Fire Protection, Warmth, Weather (when involving hot temperatures or aridity). Songs: Fire, Firewalk, Snowmelt, Warding vs. Fire Elementals. Ballads: Awaken Volcano, Firescreen, Firesight, Icemelt. Runes: Boiling, Fireblend, Flame, Inner Chill, Inner Warmth, Melting, Sputter, Warding vs. Fire Elemental.

Causes any future damage inflicted (whether magical, divine magical, or mundane) on the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to be also inflicted on the being or item which causes that damage, no matter where the inflictor is (even if on another plane). The targeted being is allowed a Magic Resistance to avoid each effect. All reciprocal damage is applied one second after the initial damage and must be the exact amount. Each listener is afforded recompense in this way for up to 1 act of receiving damage per Practitioner Title. Since this reciprocal damage is divine in nature, it occurs directly to the object or being, surpassing all hide, physical armor, and spiritual/force armor. Damage includes any and all physical effects, diseases, and insanity. Only ill effects inflicted 5 seconds after this hymn begins are recompensed in this way, not any previous damage.

Redirects the soul of an individual who followed the hymnist's deity while alive into the body of another being at the time of its birth. The deity chooses the vessel in which to place the redirected soul, and the hymnist has no say in the matter. The new body will have just been born or have animal intelligence and must be within 5 miles per Practitioner Title of the hymnist. Also, the re-incarnate loses one Will Force point permanently at the time of its birth.

Counteracts unnatural aging effects of either the hymnist, one listener who follows the hymnist's deity, one animal, or one plant, restoring any lost characteristics brought on by the aging effects. While the reverseaging effects of Rejuvenation still occur on the body of the deceased, this hymn will not restore the life of the deceased. This hymn has no effect on natural aging effects and does not restore permanently lost Will Force rating points.
Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or go berserk, as the skill Berserk.

Causes the area around the hymnist with a radius of 100 square feet per Practitioner Title to quickly change over to the opposite season, resulting in a change of temperature, vegetation, amount of sunlight, and current population of wildlife. For example, the Hymn of Seasons would transform a forested area in winter to that of summer, therefore causing vegetation to sprout its mature foliage, any hibernating animals to awaken, flowers to bloom, and the sun to appear higher in the sky (if a planetary axial tilt exists in the setting). This seasonal change lasts for 1 hour per Practitioner Title, after which the area reverts back to its previous state over the next 1 hour (flowers die, animals go back to sleep, etc.).

Allows the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity to fall into a meditative state and communicate with any bodiless spirits within a radius of 50' per Practitioner Title. Knowledge of the spirits' true names is not required, since this hymn does not allow for the calling of specific spirits. The effected listeners remain in this state, able to communicate with spirits, for 1 minute per Practitioner Title.

Creates a sphere with a radius of 10' per Practitioner Title, up to 2' per Practitioner Title away from the hymnist, where both light and darkness are suppressed, resulting in a shadowy, gray area devoid of bright light or deep darkness. Neither the living nor the dead receive any bonuses or penalties within the affected area. The sphere is centered on a fixed location when created and cannot be moved, and it lasts for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title. The hymns of Noontide and Midnight will override the Hymn of Twilight if the latter hymnist makes Hymn Lore roll by more than the previous hymnist.

Causes one active volcano within sight to suddenly erupt, spitting hot gases, smoke, and lava into the air and into the vicinity of the volcano. See Volcanic Eruptions in Legends of the Unknown. This will only occur if the hymnist's deity wishes for the volcano to erupt (at the GM's discretion). The lethality and duration of the eruption are determined by conditions of the existing volcano.

Creates a steady gust of wind moving 5 miles per hour per Practitioner Title which blows throughout an area with a 10' radius per Practitioner Title from the hymnist, causing objects to be tossed about. When this wind is felt upon bare skin and breathed in deeply, the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity are granted the skills Balance, Listen, Meditate, and Smell at 10% per Practitioner Title, lasting for as long as the listener remains within the wind. The wind lasts for 5 minutes per Practitioner Title. Furthermore, all affected listeners have a 1% chance per Practitioner Title of being soothed and cured of insanity, as per the skills, as soon as they feel the wind.

Grants the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity a +5% bonus per Practitioner Titles to the skills Candle Lore, Curse, Detect Curse, Empathy Magic, Herb Lore, Potion Lore, Ritual Lore, Speak to Dead, and Sympathy Magic for 1 hour per Practitioner title.

Creates either 3 lesser undead or 1 greater undead per 2 Practitioner Titles from the corpses of those who, while living, followed the hymnist's deity, by infusing those corpses the hymnist touches with negative life force. The type of undead is based upon the corpse and the conditions of its death (see Epitaph of the Fallen).

Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or suddenly take hostile action against each other, including derogatory words and offensive attacks. This hymn does not affect thoughts or emotions but rather releases control over each listener's innermost evil, immoral desires, and hidden, buried dislikes of those around them. Furthermore, those who fall under this hymn's affect will also attempt to convince those who have not yet taken hostile action to do so. For every 10 seconds the hymn continues, all listeners who have not yet succumbed to animosity must make a new Control Resistance with a cumulative 5% penalty. This hymn cannot last more than 10 minutes total, and once the hymn is over, the temporary aggression instantly and abruptly ends.

Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or betray a particular cause or being, resulting in a -5% per Practitioner Title to Will Force saves when attempting to perform anything which furthers that cause or is requested by that being, and will avoid defending the cause or being at all costs. Furthermore, all affected listeners have -20% to morale whenever within the vicinity of the being or acting for the good of that being or cause. Effects last 1 day per practitioner title.

Bestows a curse upon all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity, resulting in a penalty of -1 to hit and -5% to all resistance rolls per 3 Practitioner Titles, lasting 1 hour. This curse may be lifted with the skill Remove Curse.

Strikes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity blind, unless a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title is made, for 10d6 seconds. Blind beings are -8 to hit with melee weapons, -16 to hit with missile weapons, -4 to damage, -20% to all combat skills, and have no defensive modifier. Furthermore, these listeners are immune to gaze attacks (such as Fear, Brilliance, Entrancement, Illusion of Sight, and those which transform).

Summons or dismisses an Evil-aligned supernatural servant by name (the hymnist must know the true name of the servant to summon or dismiss), either of which cannot be resisted by the servant. When summoning, control is automatically granted to the hymnist if the deity wishes it, unless the supernatural servant is immune to control. When dismissing, the servant must remain within earshot of the hymnist during the entire 10 minutes of the hymn.

Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity to temporarily be unable to sense a particular being or object, either through sight, sound, touch, smell, hearing, or magical and divine magical means, for 1 minute per Practitioner Title. This is only an illusion, and an Illusion Resistance negates the effect. This does not physically remove or displace the target, and the target can still be damaged or affected by outside forces. If the being or object moves more than a couple of inches, the effect is immediately broken.

Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or grow hostile toward all personal debts or grudges. This creates desires for revenge, resulting in a -20% per Practitioner Title to Will Force rolls to immediately attempt to collect debts and or settle old scores through hostile action. Effects last 1 day per Practitioner title.

Introduces a named disease or poison to all food and water within 5' per Practitioner Title. The poison can be of a type no greater than 2 levels per Practitioner Title but takes effect immediately (Potency J) upon contact or ingestion, etc. Diseases selected cannot be magical or divine in nature. Normal Poison and Disease Resistances apply.

Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or covet that which belongs to others, whether valuable or not, resulting in the need to make a Will Force save or attempt to steal 1 item which does not belong to them every 2 minutes for the following hour.

Causes the hymnist's deity to intervene in an otherwise safe situation and divinely, miraculously inflict a highly dangerous and potentially fatal event in a particular place no larger than 1 mile per Practitioner Title or on a group of beings consisting of no more than 10 individuals per Practitioner Title, in whichever way that deity chooses. The means of damnation is completely at the GM's discretion. However, if the GM decides that the hymnist's enemies do not warrant damnation, or that performing this act does not fit into the deity's predestined plan, nothing happens. This hymn may only be sung once per month, and any further attempts may invoke the anger and wrath of that particular deity, resulting in divine denial.

Causes a divine magical pure black sphere of darkness, with a radius of 1' per Practitioner Title, to appear no further than 5' away per Will Force point. The sphere can be centered on a moveable object or being, or can be fixed in one place. All light, magical or otherwise, is non-visible while the globe is in effect. Lasts 5 minutes per Will Force of the hymnist. Only one globe per Practitioner Title may be active. Fire will still be lit within the magical sphere and will still be hot, just not visible. All forms of vision that operate within the spectrum of light are nonfunctional within the sphere (such as all forms of Night Vision, Ultravision and Infravision). The hymnist's vision is not affected by the darkness. Beings and magic items targeted get a Piety save to avoid the effects.

Strikes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity deaf, unless a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title is made, for 10d6 seconds. Deafened beings are -1 to initiative, +50% to be surprised, and +1 to be struck during combat.

Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or speak only lies and be completely unable to tell the truth in any way for 1d4 minutes. The affected beings can choose to remain silent.

Causes 1 listener per Practitioner Title who follows a Good-aligned deity to make a Control Resistance of become morally corrupt for the duration, resulting in cravings for power, money, destruction, and other evil desires. A normally calm and peaceful being would become violent if provoked or kept from fulfilling her desires. 30 minutes per Practitioner Title after the hymn ends, each affected listener reverts back to the previous alignment and loses all memory of events that transpired while corrupted. This hymn has no effect on followers of Neutral-Good deities.

Wounds any one existing body area to exactly -1 Endurance, affecting 1 listener per Practitioner Title who does not follow the hymnist's deity. Furthermore, up to 1 limb per 4 Practitioner Titles is instantaneously removed at the cost of 1 Will Force per limb, paid by the hymnist. Vital areas cannot be removed in this way. Multiple sub-areas removed (such as several fingers on the same hand) count as one limb.

Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or gain a sudden need for food and water. Those affected must eat a full meal once per hour or begin starving (subtracting 1d4+1 Base Endurance per hour) and drink 8 oz. of liquid every hour or begin dying of dehydration (subtracting 1d6+1 Base Endurance per hour). This depravation lasts for 1 full day per Practitioner Title. If Base Endurance is reduced to 0 or below, the being must make a Vitality save at -5% per point under 0 or fall unconscious and collapse. Anyone whose Base Endurance drops to 0 minus their Vitality rating dies immediately.

Causes all listeners who follow a Good-aligned deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel intense hostility and animosity toward each other, causing them to attack the nearest living being who follows a Good-aligned deity until either dead or not moving. Thereafter, a new resistance is allowed, or the listener must attack the next nearest target. This hymn will continue to affect listeners for as long as the hymnist is singing. Once the hymn ends, affected listeners immediately lose this feeling of enmity but retain all memory of the deeds they committed while under the hymn's influence.

Causes all listeners who follow one particular deity (either that of the hymnist or another) to lose all sense of bonding with each other and instead be filled with a nervous, uneasy estrangement, losing a total of 2% per Practitioner Title when collectively attempting to Commune with their deity. The affected listeners are also -30% to morale and -5% per 2 Practitioner Titles to all skills performed on each other (such as Cure Poison, Bless, etc.). In cases where the affected listeners of a single religion are bonded in a way other than through a deity, this hymn removes all means of mental and spiritual contact with each other, even overriding magical effects such as Mindlink and Emotion Sense. These effects last for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.

Causes all non-magical and non-divine locks and bindings (including rope, cuffs, etc.) to open within 1' per Practitioner Title of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity who are currently being held or imprisoned justly for committing a crime or evil deed.

Lowers the Strength rating by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (cannot be lowered below 5) of all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity if they fail a Magic Resistance. Strength points lost in this manner return at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.

Causes all listeners to be filled with an overwhelming sense of greed unless a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title is made, resulting in a desire to steal, ask for, keep, or otherwise obtain items of any value at all. This feeling ends after 1 hour.

Causes the hymnist (if willing) and all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or hate the hymn's subject (being, location, object, or idea) with all their hearts. Affected listeners must go berserk whenever in the presence of the subject and will go to any length to utterly destroy that subject. These feelings of hatred fade after 1 hour.

Lowers the Intelligence rating by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (cannot be lowered below 5) of all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity if they fail a Magic Resistance. Intelligence points lost in this manner return at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.

Inflicts a -5% per Practitioner Title penalty to Poison and Disease Resistances for 1 hour and inflicts one particular named terminal disease to all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity, unless the target makes their normal Disease Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title. This terminal disease may be either mundane, magical, or divine magical in nature.

Causes 1 listener who follows the hymnist's deity and all listeners who follow a Neutral-Good or Good-aligned deity to make a Control Resistance or indulge in all actions, beings, and places considered immoral or evil in any way for 1 hour. Indulging in such activities includes drinking solely to get drunk, participating in less than seemly activities, overeating, etc.

Lowers the Wisdom rating by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (cannot be lowered below 5) of all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity if they fail a Magic Resistance. Wisdom points lost in this manner return at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.

Inflicts one particular mild disease to all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity, unless a Disease Resistance is made. This disease may be either mundane, magical, or divine magical in nature.

Causes all listeners who follow a Neutral or Good-aligned deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or become rude and insolent in deed and speech for 1 hour. This would cause affected listeners to slander their friends, refuse to help someone in need, use foul language, become drunk at an inappropriate time, etc.

Instills in all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity with Type VI, Potency Q Poison, which gradually inflicts 1d4 damage to overall Endurance per hour for a total of 2d4 hours, unless a Poison Resistance is made.

Releases all listeners who follow the hymnist's deity from all possession and other effects of control for a temporary span of 1d4 minutes. After the duration, the listeners must make another Control Resistance or fall under the effects of their previous possession or control.

Inflicts all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity with a -2% penalty per Practitioner Title to Commune Chance and a -5% penalty per Practitioner Title to the skills Divination and Omen for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title, unless a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title is made.

Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or become extremely jealous, resulting in the need for a Will Force save to avoid attempting the skill Steal each time they become aware of someone else owning a valuable item. This includes every time the listener sees someone wearing nice clothes or jewelry, living in a nice house, eating good food, etc., at the GM's discretion. This urge lasts for 1 hour.
Inflicts a -2% per Practitioner Title penalty to Poison and Disease Resistances for 1 hour, unless a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title is made.

Causes 1 listener per Practitioner Title who does not follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel a sense of total selfishness and lack of concern for the welfare of others, resulting in a Will Force save at -5% per Practitioner Title to perform any action that would in any way be considered selfless or generous (at the GM's discretion). For example, this hymn would affect the listener's attempt at the skills Healing and Exorcism, or force someone to claim a newly found magical item or object of value whether they needed it or not. Furthermore, the listener must make a Will Force save at -5% per Practitioner Title or refuse to defend someone, either in conversation or in combat. This feeling of malevolence lasts for 1 minute per Practitioner Title.

Creates a sphere of true night, even during the day, covering the area with the darkness of midnight. All beings within the sphere are affected as if it were night. All effects which are dependent upon darkness or nighttime apply, regardless of the actual time. Thus, within the sphere of the Hymn of Midnight, a Lesser Vampire, normally debilitated during daylight hours, would function as normal while inside the sphere. The sphere, which has a radius of 10' per Practitioner Title, is centered on a fixed location (up to 2' per Practitioner Title from the hymnist) when created and cannot be moved, and it lasts for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title. The hymns of Twilight and Noontide will override the Hymn of Midnight if the latter hymnist makes a Hymn Lore roll by more than the previous hymnist.

Causes up to 2 listeners per Practitioner Title to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel an intense urge to immediately attack the nearest being, with the intent and focus of murdering them. Once the target being dies, a new resistance must be made to avoid attacking the next nearest being. This urge continues for as long as the hymnist is singing and fades 2d6 seconds after the hymn ends.

Grants a +5% per Practitioner Title bonus to 1 listener who follows a Neutral-Evil or Evil-aligned deity to the following for 1 hour: Control Undead, Flesh Lore. Candle Lore rituals: Coexist with Undead, Death Stench, Protection from Undead, Spirit Bind (when targeted at undead). Ritual Lore rituals: Bind Form, Conceal Dead, Magnify Shadow, Positive Life Vapor. Poems: Darkness, Shadow. Songs: Decay, Death Warrior. Ballads: Deadwalk, Decomposition, Mask of Death. Runes: Binding (when only activated by undead), Corruption, Mark of Death, Natural Darkness, Night.

Causes the hymnist and all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title (if unwilling) or be unable to avoid saying or doing anything that would be considered immoral or evil for 1 hour.

Causes 1 listener to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or become possessed by the hymnist for 1 hour per Practitioner Title after the hymn is complete. Once the hymn ends after 10 seconds, the hymnist is in mental contact with the target (if they remain within sight) and may take possession with 5 seconds of simple concentration (with no additional Control Resistance afforded). While in possession, the hymnist has complete control of the target, whose will is totally subverted. The hymnist's own body will stand or sit as it was. If the hymnist's body takes more than 10 points of damage, then a concentration roll (Intelligence save) is required to avoid having the hymnist's mind forcibly returned to the hymnist's body. After 1 hour per Practitioner Title, the possession target is no longer considered controlled.
Temporarily instills Xenophobia (fear of outsiders and beings who are different) in all listeners for 1 hour.

Causes all listeners who follow a Good-aligned deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or lose all humility and meekness and instead be filled with a false sense of pride and unseemly boastfulness, resulting in -1 Charm, -1 Piety per 2 Practitioner Titles, and the need to make a Will Force save at -5% per Practitioner Title to perform any action that would be considered humble or submissive (at the GM's discretion). This would include thanking someone for something or allowing someone else to partake first of food, etc. These effects last for 1 hour.

Decreases the Appearance and Charm of all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to be reduced below 5) while speaking about their own deity or performing a skill in that deity's name, such as Bless, Convert, Exorcism, Hymn Lore, etc. This effect lasts for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title.

Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist's deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or perform 2d4 actions contrary to the teachings, beliefs, or standards of their own particular deity. This would include cursing in the deity's name, stealing a divine item imbued by that deity, speaking badly of that deity, murdering, lying, refusing to perform necessary religious rites, etc.

Lowers the Will Force saves of all listeners by 5% per Practitioner Title when being tempted to take any action that would be considered evil, resulting in possible alignment checks. This temptation lasts for 2 hours after the hymn ends.

Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel an overwhelming urge to protect their territory, whether it be their residence, favorite location, campsite, etc., by attacking any outsiders or visitors (animal, plant, or otherwise) and going to any means necessary to make their territory more physically appealing by repairing, decorating, etc. The listener will also attempt to make known the fact to others that the territory belongs to them, either through writing or other means. This feeling of territorialism lasts for 1 hour.

Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or temporarily become extremely vain and obsessed over their physical appearance. Over the next hour, the affected listeners must go to any extreme to make themselves more physically attractive, no matter the cost. This may result in an increased Appearance rating and/or a decreased Charm rating, or both at the GM's discretion.
Cause listeners to roll at +30% to Berserking and fight the opponent(s) named in the poem. Lasts until end of combat or 1d4 hours.
All listeners must make a Control Resistance or be held bound in place for 1d6 minutes.
All listeners must make a Control Resistance or be blinded for 1d6 minutes.
All listeners must make a Control Resistance or follow instructions within the poem. All life threatening or dangerous actions called for allow a new Control Resistance roll.
The most damaged area on each listener is healed 1d4 per Practitioner Title.
Causes an illusion to appear with visual and audio components only. Lasts 10-40 minutes.
Causes all users to make a Control Resistance or listen to skill user for 10-40 minutes. Other actions may be taken by the listeners while they listen.
Causes a -20% to all Control Resistances required to be made from any effect generated from the skill user. Causes a +20% to all affinity or skill rolls against the skill user. Lasts 1d4 hours.
Grants 2-5 luck points to each listener to be used (as the spell Luck).
An area of the practitioner's choice on enemies is damaged by 1d4 per Practitioner Title.
All items or beings that are invisible, or hidden by illusion are revealed to the listeners for the duration of the poem for up to 2-7 (1d6+1) minutes.
The skill user grants 2-5 unlucky points against each listener to be used by the practitioner against the listeners (as the spell Unluck).
All sleeping beings awake instantly and are fully alert. All effects of fatigue are removed from awakened sleepers.
All listeners make a Control Resistance or fall into a deep slumber for 3d6 minutes.
Causes a small fire to begin on normal combustible material pointed to during recitation.

Gives the lorist or one person named per Practitioner Title an enhanced ability to jump, spring, leap and move +2' to running jumps, +1' to standing and +1/2' to upward leaps. Movement is increased by +1' per second or +10' per 10 seconds and +1 mile per hour travelled. Lasts 10-60 minutes.
This poem will cause all animals who hear it to go to their nearest known natural source of drinking water. Does not affect magical animals.
All animals who hear the poem are broken free of any spell, invocation, poem, song or ballad by which they are currently controlled. Does not affect magical animals.

Creates a sphere of darkness with a radius of 2' per Practitioner Title appears up to 3' per Practitioner Title away from the poet for the duration of the poem. All forms of vision are negated to all within the globe, even the poet. The sphere can be centered on a fixed location, but the globe will not move from the point where it was created.

All shadows within 3' per Practitioner Title may be molded and shaped according to the poet's will for the duration of the poem. Each shadow may be moved from one place to another, enlarged by up to 50%, or condensed into an area 50% of its original size.
One lesser undead being (under level 5) per Practitioner Title within 5' per Practitioner Title makes a Control Resistance or is unable to take any offensive actions for the duration of the poem.
One listener per Practitioner Title is protected from fire-based attacks from undead, receiving a +30% to Magic Resistance (fire) involving undead during the duration of the poem.

One listener per Practitioner Title is protected from poisons caused by contact with undead, receiving a +30% Poison Resistance involving undead during the duration of the poem. Poisons already in effect are unaffected by this poem.
Causes 1d4 branches (not weighing more than 10 pounds each per Practitioner Title) on a targeted tree within 10' per Practitioner Title to break off at the trunk and fall.
Grants the Practitioner a general sense of cardinal compass directions.
Causes 1d4 fingers and toes of 1 listener named in the poem to become instantly frostbitten, causing 1d4 damage per Practitioner Title unless a Magic Resistance is made.

Causes 1 listener per Practitioner Title to suddenly feel guilty about some random thing they did in the past, unless a Control Resistance is made. For the next 1d4 hours per Practitioner Title after the poem has ended, the affected being must make a Will Force save to perform any actions involving any similarities to the recalled event. For example, if the poem causes a Rogue to feel guilty about three silver pieces they stole when they were young, the Rogue will be hesitant to pickpocket at the marketplace this afternoon.
Grants Enhanced Night Vision to the poet and 1 listener per Practitioner Title for 2d6 minutes.

Allows the poet to shape and manipulate the density of 3 cubic feet of dry sand (both magical and non-magical) per Practitioner Title, within a range of 50' per Practitioner Title. The poet can either transform a hard block of sandstone into loose sand, or vice versa, taking any shape desired. This poem has no effect on stone which is not comprised of densely packed sand. Furthermore, any attempt to manipulate mud will not work until the water is completely removed.

Causes 1 sleeping listener to make a Control Resistance or stand up and rigidly act out their current dream. Each dream ends in 4d4 seconds, and once the dream ends, the target has a 50% chance to either lie back down or to remain standing and begin a new dream. The target will continue to act out each dream for as long as the poem endures, but they receive a new Control Resistance (each at +5% per Practitioner Title) to perform each new dream.

Allows the poet to shape or displace 3 cubic feet of both magical and non-magical snow per Practitioner Title, either creating a tall snowdrift, uncovering bare ground, or simply moving it from one place to another within a range of 10' per Practitioner Title. This poem has no effect on water, slush or ice.

Allows the poet and 1 listener per Practitioner Title the ability to walk as if weightless on snow, slush, or ice for the duration of the poem. Affected listeners leave behind no tracks. Upon stepping onto any other surface, the listeners' weight acts normally.

Causes the core temperature of the poet and 1 listener per Practitioner Title to rise by .5 degrees Fahrenheit per 2 Practitioner Titles, granting each affected listener the feeling of sitting near a camp fire or standing in hot sunlight. The poet can control the maximum amount of warmth gained, and if not careful, fever will ensue.
Grants the poet a general idea of what the weather will be like in the current area (10 square miles per Practitioner Title) over the next 24 hours per Practitioner Title.

Causes the poet and 1 listener per Practitioner Title to grow webbing between their toes, fingers and paws, resulting in a +10% bonus to the skill Swimming and -1 penalty to Appearance when visible. This poem does not affect hooves or fins.

Causes 1 listener per Practitioner Title to make a Control Resistance or fall into a deep slumber after which they make a Magic Resistance or they are sent to the plane of dreams (without their bodies).

Grants the power of flight 3' per Intelligent point and levitate to the reciter and 1 being per Practitioner title. The effect lasts 1d4+1 hours per Practitioner title. Only works on the ethereal plane.

Makes a symbol that only the practitioner can see appear above the head of one being per Practitioner title. The symbol indicates to the practitioner what the being's plane of origin is. Non-detection is proof against this effect. This effect lasts 1 minute per practitioner title.

Turns an ordinary door into a doorway to the Phase Plane for 1 minute per Practitioner title. Does not work on planes not connected to the Phase Plane. If used on the Phase Plane it creates a doorway to the natural universe.
Opens one portal within sight that has been used within one day per Practitioner title. The portal stays open for 10 minutes per Practitioner title.
One supernatural being per practitioner title is afforded the opportunity to return to their plane of origin to their home or other known safe place.

Reveals one portal per practitioner title within sight. Above the portal a symbol(s) appears that only the practitioner can see, that reveals where the plane the portal is connected to. This effect lasts 1 minute per practitioner title.

Turns an ordinary door into a doorway to the Plane of Shadow for 1 minute per practitioner title. Does not work on planes not connected to the Shadow Plane. If used on the Shadow Plane it creates a doorway to the natural universe.

Causes a pile of parts to assemble into a combined object into a combined object of no more than 1 cubic foot per Practitioner title, imagined by the poet. If fasteners are present then these will screw, drive, connect, or fasten the object together otherwise magical glue (as the spell Adhere) at 20 lb. per Practitioner title of strength will do so permanently. The quality of the item will depend on the quality of the parts and/or the related social skill of the poet. Complex objects of one material type (like locks) cannot be assembled in this manner.
Grants Ultravision to the poet and up to 1 other ally per Practitioner Title. Ultravision lasts for 1 hour per Class title.
Grants the practitioner and up to 1 other ally per Practitioner Title +20% to Truth Tell, Detect Alignment, Decipher, and Control Resistances for 1 hour per Class Title.

Causes 1 non-magical item of no more than 1 cubic foot per Practitioner title, made up of combined parts to fall apart into its constituent parts. This means fasteners of all types are removed and join the pile of parts. Complex objects of one material type (like locks) are immune to this effect.
Grants the practitioner and up to 1 other ally per Practitioner Title +20% to Meditate, Body Control, Sense Projection, and Spirit Travel for 10 minutes per Class Title after the poem completes.
Causes 1 ghost, insubstantial spirit, or insubstantial undead per Practitioner title to become freed of control and/or binding to a specific location or object for 1 hour per Class Title.
Grants +1/+5% per Practitioner Title towards the next named, planned action that can occur up to 10 minutes after the poem completes.

Causes one object to become a focus for 1 ghost, insubstantial spirit, or insubstantial undead per Practitioner title if they fail a Control Resistance. Those affected are drawn to and focused on the object and unable to leave the sight of it for 1 hour per Class Title.
Causes a rift in a love union unless both lovers make a Control Resistance.
Causes a favorable reaction from one individual unless a Control Resistance is made.
Control by verbal command a single visualized individual. If harmful, a Control Resistance is allowed to escape the commands.
Vitality is increased by 1d4 for one day for 1 individual; new Poison Resistance and Disease Resistance at +30% thereafter for one full day.
Links the minds of a group of people (one person per Practitioner Title). Each one senses the others' thoughts and can speak and be heard telepathically for up to one hour per Practitioner Title).
Gives 2-5 luck points to any individual visualized including self. A luck point gives a +1 or +5% modifier to any roll, modifying it up or down to the lucky being's advantage.
Gives +10 to current Aura pool, +4 to Aura Control and +20% to Magic Resistance to 1 individual.
Removes the current control effects from one individual and allows a +50% to Control Resistance for one day.
Lesser undead (creature level 1-4) within sight must make a Magic Resistance or be destroyed.
Allows user to scry on an individual, object or place for one hour per Practitioner Title, as the skill Scrying.
User gets vision of the nearest hidden treasure and is able to sense where it lies and the general contents of the treasure.
Causes one opponent to make a Control Resistance or suffer -1d4 physical attributes for one full day.
An offering is made to the deity in question. If the offer is suitable, the motive clear and the ritual successful, atonement is achieved and all alignment checks are removed.
If performed on the day of burial, all dead buried cannot rise as undead or ever be used for dark purposes of any kind.
Remove all controlling magic from any living being. Curses and magical diseases such a lycanlhropy are unaffected.

Used to marry two persons in a legal and binding fashion in the eye of the religion and possibly the society. The marriage is thus blessed and any attempts to disrupt the marriage involving magic are at -10% to the skill rolls and +10% to the married couple's resistance rolls. The couple cannot be affected by the Hate or Love ritual.

Both parties agree to the conditions of a pact. If either party breaks the pact, that person suffers a curse per the Curse skill rules. The modifier of the ritual should be difference of the rating of the curse used in the ritual versus Ritual Lore (15), (as the skill Curse). The Ritual Lore practitioner does not need to have the Curse skill.

The practitioner performs this ritual and binds 1 animal or magical animal familiar to the ritualist. The effects are identical to the spell Bind Familiar, with the exception that no Will Force is given up. The familiar must be a creature of type animal or magical animal. A Ritual Lore practitioner may only have 1 animal familiar and 1 magical animal familiar at a time (allowing for 2 familiars).

The practitioner performs this ritual in an area of forest no larger than 100 yards per practitioner Title.  All of the plants within this area become immune to fire and cannot burn as long as they remain in this area.
The practitoner can find the location of one specific known and named animal or magical animal.
The practitioner can sense all animals or magical animals of one type in a named area. For example, the practitioner can sense all dire wolves in the Black Forest.

Allows the practitioner to bind a currently controlled physical undead creature (with neither Soul nor Spirit) to a repetitive task or guard a general area, externalizing control of the undead for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.
Causes any corpses within the affected area (10' radius per Practitioner Title) to become undetectable by any sense.
Allows the practitioner to disguise their life force as an opposite form, lasting 30 minutes per Practitioner Title.

The ritual of writing one's Epitaph must be done in the blood of the focus being and contain their true name. This prevents the Soul from being removed from their body or controlled in any fashion. The Epitaph must remain intact and untouched by any other being; otherwise, the Epitaph is nullified.
Causes the earth to loosen and give way, opening a grave 3' wide x 7' long x 6' deep. Any beings within 5' of the area must make an Agility save at half in order not to fall in.

The flames used in this ritual emit a dark magical light, magnifying all shadows within a 50' radius to twice their original size. Beings caught within the shadow are affected as if having to sense, act and attack in normal darkness.
The smoke used in this ritual envelopes 1 being per Practitioner Title, masking them with negative life force. Any being actively Life Sensing will have a 25% chance to see past the vapor.
Temporarily relieves the effects of a non-terminal curse on 1 present being for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.

Plagues 1 being per Practitioner Title with a single night of continual nightmares. The ritualist can only use a target they can visualize. Any amount of time used to rest while inflicted with nightmares is considered at 1/2, resulting in any natural forms of fatigue. Each time the target awakens after having these nightmares, they have a 1% chance per Practitioner Title of gaining a random Insanity.

A complex ritual, the Obituary rips a person's Soul from the body, killing them instantly. The ritualist must have the victim's true name, handwritten by the victim themselves in blood. A target with a written Epitaph (as per the Ritual) is immune to this ritual.
The smoke used in this ritual envelopes 1 being per Practitioner Title, masking them with positive life force. Any being actively Life Sensing will have a 25% chance to see past the vapor.

Temporarily removes conversion effects (including undead) for 1 being, preventing its Soul from being controlled. The Soul is bound to the body 30 minutes extra per Practitioner Title of the ritualist.
Performed over any dead or undead body, this ritual draws out the Soul, releasing it from the body.
The flame used in this ritual emits a magical light, removing all shadows within a 50' radius. Beings using the skill Shadow Walk will be unable to come within 50' of the focal point.

Allows the practitioner to reveal a disguised life force within a 20' radius. If any life force disguising effect is active within the radius, there is a contest of target's Will Force vs. the ritualist's Practitioner Title x2
Creates a translucent sphere that attracts swarms of insects within its grasp and then constricts around them, killing all inside. The sphere will reach a radius of 1' per Practitioner Title.
Causes the fabric surrounding 1 being per Practitioner Title to unravel. There is a 30% chance that the unraveled cloth will entangle the affected being, causing them to lose 2d6 seconds of action.
Allows the caster to direct any currently present non-magical wind in whatever direction choosen for 30 minutes per Practitioner Title.

Causes clouds to form overhead and produce constant rain for the following 24 hours. This rain falls in a 1/2 mile radius around the point where the ritual is performed. This ritual has no effect if the ambient temperature is below freezing. Note: The rain created in this fashion is not magical in any way, nor can this ritual create rain in a magical environment such as an Enchanted Area or a magical plane or in areas where there is not enough moisture to create the clouds, such as a desert.

Allows the practitioner to mentally contact a stone surface no larger than 5'x 5'x 5' for 30 seconds per Practitioner Title. The stone becomes aware of what has happened to it and around it. This temporary awareness allows the stone to have roughly equal Intelligence to the ritualist. After the allotted time, the awareness leaves, and the ritualist cannot contact that particular area of stone again that day.

Causes clouds to form overhead and produce constant snowfall and winds of 10 mph per Practitioner Title (see Masters Manual, Combat weather effects for the effects of wind) for the following 24 hours. This storm occurs in 1/2 mile radius around the point where the ritual is performed. This ritual has no effect if the ambient temperature is above freezing. Note: The snow and wind created in this fashion is not magical in any way, nor can this ritual create snow and wind in a magical environment such as an Enchanted Area or a magical plane.

Allows the ritualist to call any chosen weather conditions to occur in a radius of 2 miles per Practitioner Title around the point where the ritual is performed. The created weather effect endures for 12 hours per Practitioner Title. This ritual can be performed under any ambient temperature. Note: Weather conditions created in this fashion are not magical in any way, nor can this ritual alter weather in a magical environment such as an Enchanted Area or a magical plane.

Allows the ritualist and up to one other per practitioner title to be protected from electricity and pressure as well as be able to fly at up to 3' per Intelligence rating (requires concentration.) These effects are only active while on the Plane of Air. This effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title. Ritual Components: Blood, nails, hair, or skin from a being or creature of the Plane of Air.

Allows the ritualist and up to one other per practitioner title to be protected from Aura and Chaos effects and pressure as well as being able to fly at up to 3' per Intelligence rating. These effects are only active while on the Plane of Chaos/Magic. This effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title. Ritual Components: Blood, nails, hair, or skin of a being or creature of the Plane of Chaos.

Allows the ritualist and up to one other per practitioner title to be protected from death magic, aging and pressure as well as breathless and being able to fly at up to 3' per Intelligence rating. These effects are only active while on the Plane of Void/Death. This effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title. Ritual Components: Blood, nails, hair, or skin of a being or creature of the Plane of Void/Death.

Allows the ritualist and up to one other per practitioner title to be protected from poison, sleep, and hold effects. They can also blink once per 10 seconds to anywhere they can see. These effects are only active while on the Dream Plane. This effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title. Ritual Components: Blood, nails, hair, or skin of a being or creature of the Plane of Dreams.

Practitioner performs this ritual for 10 minutes+5 minutes per focus for up to 1 being (or creature) per practitioner title. For 2 hours per practitioner title, the targets are immune to pressure effects, and may subsist on 25% of their normal air volume requirement. This does not negate temperature effects, and may be renewed as often as necessary. This also enables the focuses to breathe polluted or poisoned air without consequence, provided the pollutant does not comprise more than 75% of the total volume breathed. This does not grant the ability to breathe underwater, or the ability to breathe in outer space, or other environments where air density is less than 1/4 normal. Ritual Components: A damp cloth that has been rubbed with ashes or infused with smoke.

Allows the ritualist and up to one other per practitioner title to be protected from acid and pressure as well as be able being able to climb any surface as if their hands and feet are adhere-able (up to 500 lb.). These effects are only active while on the Plane of Earth. This effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title. Ritual Components: Blood, nails, hair, or skin from a being or creature of the Plane of Earth.

Allows the ritualist and up to one other per practitioner title to be protected from heat and pressure as well as be able being able to walk on lava or any other superheated liquid. These effects are only active while on the Plane of Fire. This effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title. Ritual Components: Blood, nails, hair, or skin from a being or creature of the Plane of Fire.

Allows the ritualist and up to one other per practitioner title to be protected from light, life magic, and breathless, as well as be able being able to fly at up to 3' per Intelligence rating. These effects are only active while on the Plane of Light/Life. This effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title. Ritual Components: Blood, nails, hair, or skin from a being or creature of the Plane of Light/Life.

Allows the ritualist and up to one other per practitioner title to be protected from cold, pressure, as well as be able to walk on water. These effects are only active while on the Plane of Water. This effect lasts 1 hour per practitioner title. Ritual Components: Blood, nails, hair, or skin from a being or creature of the Plane of Water.

The practitioner performs the ritual while imagining a plane they want to travel to and then can feel the direction (but not distance) of the nearest planar portal to that plane up to 10 miles away per practitioner title. May only be attempted once per day.

Practitioner takes 5 minutes + time spoken. All words spoken before the end of the ritual are written on a surface designated during the ritual. (The practitioner indicates the end of the ritual by touching the surface upon which the writing has appeared.) The writing and the surface become magical, being unable to be destroyed or obscured via conventional means. (For example, writing on paper will not fade or run, cannot be blotted out, and the paper will not warp when exposed to water.) The practitioner may specify a length of time for the writing to remain; otherwise, it lasts for the duration of the practitioner's lifetime. Ritual Components: A surface to write on, and a material which can mark it. (ink and paper, chalk and stone, etc.).

Grants +20% to Move Unseen, Move Unheard, Blend, Shadowing for those skills for one focus. Potential opponents (non-allies) are -20% to Listen, Smell, Life Sensing, etc. for the being(s) protected. For non-allies on watch and alert, Double Perceptions to notice the concealed are converted to Single Perceptions. Ritual Components: Gray Fabric.

Grants special effect(s) by type to the practitioner and 1 other focus per class title. A being may only have 1 Clarity ritual effect at a time. Intent: extra Concentration Save (INT save) when 1st fails.

Grants special effect(s) by type to the practitioner and 1 other focus per class title. A being may only have 1 Clarity ritual effect at a time. Purpose: +5% resistances and saves when working to complete a specified goal or task.
Grants special effect(s) by type to the practitioner and 1 other focus per class title. A being may only have 1 Clarity ritual effect at a time. Reality: +10% Illusion Resistance.

Grants special effect(s) by type to the practitioner and 1 other focus per class title. A being may only have 1 Clarity ritual effect at a time. Focus: +10% to 1 specified skill that uses Mental or Mystical attributes.
Grants special effect(s) by type to the practitioner and 1 other focus per class title. A being may only have 1 Clarity ritual effect at a time. Order: +10% Magic Resistance.
Grants special effect(s) by type to the practitioner and 1 other focus per class title. A being may only have 1 Clarity ritual effect at a time. Chaos: +10% resistances/saves against Divine Effects.
Grants special effect(s) by type to the practitioner and 1 other focus per class title. A being may only have 1 Clarity ritual effect at a time. Body: +5 END, +10% Poison/Disease Resistances.

Grants special effect(s) by type to the practitioner and 1 other focus per class title. A being may only have 1 Clarity ritual effect at a time. Mind: +5% Perception, +10% resistances/saves against effects which cause insanity, control or possession.

Grants special effect(s) by type to the practitioner and 1 other focus per class title. A being may only have 1 Clarity ritual effect at a time. Spirit: +10% to Affinity and +10% resistances/saves against effects which drain or change Personal attributes.

Grants special effect(s) by type to the practitioner and 1 other focus per class title. A being may only have 1 Clarity ritual effect at a time. Soul: +10% to Fortune and +10% resistances/saves to avoid undead effects and mystical draining effects.

Removes any current poison and disease effects, as well as stabilizing all wounds to 1 END above 0 (if below). Ritual Components: 2 drops of blood from the performer and they must have affection or friendship for the focus.

Calls to the nearest Deva on the same plane (under 10th level). There is a 1% chance a Dragon comes instead. The Dragon is unlikely to be pleased unless the reward is great. The Deva (or Dragon) may make a Control Resistance to resist (if desired). Once present it will make itself known to practitioner. At that time the practitioner can make a demand and offer something valuable as payment. If the request is a one the that the Deva approves of it may refuse the payment. If the payment is approved and the Deva can help it will take the payment and help as able. Ritual Components: Fur or skin from a magical animal.

Practitioner performs the ritual only on themselves. If the ritualist dies serving their deity or a named cause then they are given a final act. This amounts to 1 full 10 seconds of action in combat (or 1 minute outside of combat) per practitioner title to perform their final acts. Death is held in abeyance during this time as if the blow that killed them never struck or action that did failed. They can continue on for the time allotted or until death occurs again. At the end of the proscribed period there is a flash and the effects that caused the original death occur and the being falls dead instantly. This final death cannot be avoided save by wish or miracle. Ritual Components: A pinch of dried skin or hair of the practitioner.

Practitioner performs this ritual on themselves or a single individual. During the ritual the being swears service sacrifices some small part of themselves (see components) and then gives a token to the person they serve. This ritual allows the serving target to mentally send one message per day to the person they serve that reaches them regardless of location (even across planes). Also, the being served knows whether the server is alive and where generally where the target is (direction and distance if on the same plane, what plane they are on if not) based on holding the token. If the server dies or the pact is broken the token breaks as well. What broke the pact (death or dissolution is not known). Ritual Components: Blood, nail or hair clippings of the server and a personal token of the server to be given to the served.

Requires the burial place or body of where the spirit died or any anchoring object that the spirit prizes or prized while alive. Spirit (and the attached soul) has all control and insanity temporarily removed, allowing the spirit a moment of clarity (for 1 minute per practitioner title.) During this time the spirit is afforded the opportunity to move on to the proper plane based on their type. Good beings go to the heavenly planes, evil to the hellish and neutral or unaligned to purgatory. Spirits or spirit beings from other planes can return to their proper place. Moving on (or returning) is a voluntary act. Ritual Components: Earth of the burial site or special item.

A supernatural being can be asked one question and will whisper one reply only they can hear. The supernatural being is not present. If no specific supernatural being is named (by true name) any can answer and the advice may be suspect. Ritual Components: Heirloom
Gives +1 Agility to the item or individual who possesses the Balance rune.
Gives +2 Agility to the item or individual who possesses the Balance rune(Greater).
Gives full protection against all normal types of cold. The possessor or surface never takes more than half damage vs. cold, even magical.
Gives immunity to all types of cold, magical or mundane.
Gives full protection against all normal types of heat. The possessor or surface never takes more than half damage vs. heat, even magical.
Gives immunity to all types of heat, magical or mundane.
