Gives full protection against all normal types of electricity. The possessor or surface never takes more than half damage vs. electricity, even magical.
Gives immunity to all types of electricity, magical or mundane.
Gives full protection against all normal types of acid. The possessor or surface never takes more than half damage vs. acid, even magical.
Gives immunity to all types of acid, magical or mundane.

If placed on an item(Radiating): Anyone viewing, touching or passing within 1' of the Flame rune will burst into flames like the spell Produce Fire. If placed on a person(Perceived): This method grants the possessor the power Produce Fire just like the spell of the same name. Both powers listed above are once per day. Treat Aura Level as that of the practitioner's Class Title x2.

If placed on an item(Radiating): Anyone viewing, touching or passing within 2' of the Flame(Greater) rune will burst into flames like the spell Produce Fire. If placed on a person(Perceived): This method grants the possessor the power Produce Fire just like the spell of the same name. Both powers listed above are once per day. Treat Aura Level as that of the practitioner's Class Title x4.
Gives +1 Vitality to the item or individual who possesses the Health rune. Also Poison Resistance and Disease Resistance are at an additional +5% (over the increase already for +1 Vitality).

Gives +2 Vitality to the item or individual who possesses the Health(Greater) rune. Also Poison Resistance and Disease Resistance are at an additional +10% (over the increase already for +2 Vitality).
Gives one luck point to the item or individual who possesses the Luck rune per day. A luck point gives a +1 or +5% modifier to any one roll.
Gives two luck points to the item or individual who possesses the Luck(Greater) rune per day. A luck point gives a +1 or +5% modifier to any one roll.
Gives +1 Strength to the individual possessing the rune of Might.
Gives +2 Strength to the individual possessing the rune of Might(Greater).
Gives +3 to Aura Pool, and +3 Aura Control to the item or individual who possesses the rune of Power.
Gives +6 to Aura Pool, and +6 Aura Control to the item or individual who possesses the rune of Power(Greater).
Gives +10% Control Resistance to the item or individual who possesses the Protection rune.
Gives +20% Control Resistance to the item or individual who possesses the Protection(Greater) rune.
The possessor of the rune of Sight gains Infravision 30', or +30' if already having Infravision.
The possessor of the rune of Sight(Greater) gains Infravision 60', or +60' if already having Infravision.
Able to speak to one animal at a time in a 20' area (as Speak to Animal skill).
Able to speak to one animal at a time in a 40' area (as Speak to Animal skill).
Able to sense the emotions of one being at a time in a radius of 1' per Wisdom rating.
Able to sense the emotions of one being at a time in a radius of 2' per Wisdom rating.
Able to speak to one plant at a time in a 20' area (as Speak to Plant skill).
Able to speak to one plant at a time in a 40' area (as Speak to Plant skill).
Able to speak to one spirit at a time in a 20' area (as Speak to Dead skill).
Able to speak to one spirit at a time in a 40' area (as Speak to Dead skill).
Able to read and/or project thoughts to or from one being at a time in a radius of 3' per Intelligence rating.
Able to read and/or project thoughts to or from one at a time in a radius of 6' per Intelligence rating.
Gives +5% to all detection skills (such as Detect Good, Detect Magic, Detect Traps) to the item or individual who possesses the Truth rune.
Gives +10% to all detection skills (such as Detect Good, Detect Magic, Detect Traps) to the item or individual who possesses the Truth(Greater) rune.

Causes a predetermined illusion to cover the item or individual who possesses the Veil rune. The veil is an Illusion of Sight (as the spell) only and is set to the specific illusion at the time if its creation.

Causes predetermined illusions to cover the item or individual who possesses the Veil rune. The veil is an Illusion of both Sight and Sound (as the spells) only and is set to the specific illusions at the time if its creation.
Protection vs. animals, insects and plants. Named animal, insect or plant type must stay at least 10' away from the rune. Sapient plants/animals get a Control Resistance.
Protection vs. animals, insects and plants. Named 2 animal, insect or plant types must stay at least 20' away from the rune. Sapient plants/animals get a Control Resistance.
One specific race must be chosen at the time of its creation, and if a member of that race comes within 15' of the rune, they must make Control Resistance or be forced to leave the area immediately.
Two specific races must be chosen at the time of its creation, and if a member of that race comes within 30' of the rune, they must make Control Resistance or be forced to leave the area immediately.

One specific type of lesser or greater undead (under Creature level 9) must be chosen at the time of its creation, and if that type of undead comes within 15' of the rune, they must a Control Resistance or be forced to leave the area immediately.

Two specific types of lesser or greater undead (under Creature level 9) must be chosen at the time of its creation, and if that type of undead comes within 30' of the rune, they must a Control Resistance or be forced to leave the area immediately.

One specific type of supernatural must be chosen at the time of its creation, and if that type of supernatural comes within 15' of the rune, they must a Control Resistance or be forced to leave the area immediately.

Two specific types of supernatural must be chosen at the time of its creation, and if that type of supernatural comes within 30' of the rune, they must a Control Resistance or be forced to leave the area immediately.
When inscribed onto a missile weapon, this rune will give +l to hit and +ld6+1 to damage per 5 Class Titles of the inscriber.
When inscribed onto a missile weapon, this rune will give +2 to hit and +2d6+2 to damage per 5 Class Titles of the inscriber.
Makes the rune bearer ambidextrous.
All divine magic except Spiritual Wall and Spirit Sphere within 60' of the rune loses its magical divinity while within this range.
All divine magic except Spiritual Wall and Spirit Sphere within 120' of the rune loses its magical divinity while within this range.
All magic except Wall and Sphere of Protection within 60' of the rune loses its magical properties while within this range.
All magic except Wall and Sphere of Protection within 120' of the rune loses its magical properties while within this range.

For each rating point above 4 (per -5% Modifier) the rune grants one point of hide only in the body area or surface it protects, up to 30 points maximum. Each body area may have one rune inscribed upon it. The rune can also be inscribed upon a piece of armor which covers multiple body areas

For each rating point above 12 (per -5% Modifier) the rune grants two points of hide only in the body area or surface it protects, up to 30 points maximum. Each body area may have one rune inscribed upon it. The rune can also be inscribed upon a piece of armor which covers multiple body areas
When inscribed onto a smashing weapon, this rune will give +l to hit and +ld6+1 to damage per 5 Class Titles of the inscriber.
When inscribed onto a smashing weapon, this rune will give +2 to hit and +2d6+2 to damage per 5 Class Titles of the inscriber.

When inscribed upon the surface of a wall, this rune will cause a shimmering door to appear, no larger than 5' wide by 10' tall. The wall cannot be more than 2 inches thick. This doorway can opened or closed by touching the rune and saying an activation word. When closed, the door appears as a normal wall but the rune can be seen. This rune includes the activation condition.

When inscribed upon the surface of a wall, this rune will cause a shimmering door to appear, no larger than 10' wide by 20' tall. The wall cannot be more than 4 inches thick. This doorway can opened or closed by touching the rune and saying an activation word. When closed, the door appears as a normal wall but the rune can be seen. This rune includes the activation condition.
Causes all of one particular type of being who see the rune to make a Control Resistance or suffer a heart attack.
Causes all of two particular types of beings who see the rune to make a Control Resistance or suffer a heart attack.
Causes an apparent +2 to all Personal attributes of the rune bearer. The effects are illusionary.
Causes an apparent +4 to all Personal attributes of the rune bearer. The effects are illusionary.
Causes all of one particular type of being who see the rune to make a Magic Resistance when first viewing it or suffer 4d6 damage in the mid torso from stomach pain.
Causes all of one particular two types of beings who see the rune to make a Magic Resistance when first viewing it or suffer 8d6 damage in the mid torso from stomach pain.
Causes the being who sees the rune to make a Control Resistance or be forced to forget a valuable item and drop it near the rune.
Causes the being who sees the rune to make a Control Resistance or be forced to forget two valuable items and drop them near the rune.
When inscribed onto a piercing weapon, this rune will give +l to hit and +ld6+1 to damage per 5 Class Titles of the inscriber.
When inscribed onto a piercing weapon, this rune will give +2 to hit and +2d6+2 to damage per 5 Class Titles of the inscriber.
When inscribed onto a cutting weapon, this rune will give +l to hit and +ld6+1 to damage per 5 Class Titles of the inscriber.
When inscribed onto a cutting weapon, this rune will give +2 to hit and +2d6+2 to damage per 5 Class Titles of the inscriber.
For every rating point above 18 (per -5% Modifier), the rune adds +l second per round per 10 second round (max +5 seconds).
For every rating point above 26 (per -5% Modifier), the rune adds +2 seconds per round per 10 second round (max +10 seconds).
Protection vs. magical animals, magical insects and magical plants. Named type must stay at least 15' away from the rune. Sapient plants/animals get a Control Resistance.
Protection vs. magical animals, magical insects and magical plants. Named 2 types must stay at least 30' away from the rune. Sapient plants/animals get a Control Resistance.
Causes All plants and non-magical animals within sight of the rune to wither and die. Plants cannot grow back as long as the rune is exposed.
Grants the rune bearer one animal ability as per the skill Evoke. A being may only have one Evocation rune inscribed upon the body at a time. It takes 2-7 seconds to activate the ability.

Grants the rune bearer two animal abilities as per the skill Evoke. A being may only have one Evocation(Greater) rune inscribed upon the body at a time. It takes 2-7 seconds to activate each ability, separately.

This rune may only be placed on a being under control or possession by another being or effect. Once the rune is inscribed successfully, control is broken and the being is immune from any further control or possession of any type from that original source.

At the time of creation, the user infuses this rune with a single command. The first time a being comes into range of the rune (1' radius per Practitioner Title) or perceives it, a Control Resistance is made or the command must be obeyed. Undead and living beings with less than 16 Will Force are afforded no Control Resistance. The command cannot force the individual to kill or directly harm herself, or knowingly place herself in jeopardy of death or destruction. The command must be one sentence or less and will be obeyed for 1 minute per Practitioner Title. Thereafter, the affected being is released from the command and becomes immune to further effects from that particular rune.

At the time of creation, the user infuses this rune with up to two commands. Creates one 10' x 10' x 10' excavation per minute. Only works on rock and earth. The excavation is shorn up only for the duration of the song and under most conditions will collapse immediately after the end of the song unless the wall are braced.

All listeners of a named type must make a Control Resistance or flee the sound of the song. If the Resitance is made a new roll is required to take hostile action. This is required for each new opponent.

All animals of one named type who hear the song and fail a Control Resistance (most are 0%) will come to the singer and follow any requests they wish for as long as the song is sung.  If a request will cause harm to the animal, the animal gets a new Control Resistance.  If the singer attempts to entrance an animal who has been tamed by the skill Tame Animal, then the Song Lore practitioner must win a contest of skills with the Tame Animal practitioner to entrance the animal.

This song will cause all plants and tree branches to bend and sway out of the path of the singer, creating a walkway through areas of impassible vegetation. The plants will return to their normal position after the singer has passed. This song will take its effect on plants or plant walls created from spells or invocations, but will not affect creatures of type Magical Plant.

A sense of peace overcomes all animals who hear the song, and they will cease all hostile action and will initiate no new hostile actions while the song is being sung. If attacked, animals are allowed a new Control Resistance to fight back. Only animals which have been tamed with the Tame Animal skill are allowed an initial Control Resistance; all animals are allowed one if attacked. Does not affect magical animals.
One lesser or greater undead being per Practitioner Title within 5' per Practitioner Title makes a Control Resistance or is unable to take any offensive actions for the duration of the song.

The skin and muscles of 1 listener of the singer's choosing slowly decays, inflicting 1d4 damage per second to 1 random body area for the duration of the song. The victim is allowed a Magic Resistance for each second of damage.

During the duration of the song, 1 being per Practitioner Title of a certain undead type (mentioned in song) is granted +1 to hit, +2 damage per 2 Practitioner Titles, a defensive adjustment of -1 per Practitioner Title, and +5% Resistances per Practitioner Title.

One skeleton per Practitioner Title, equal to or lower level than the Practitioner Title, are held in place for the duration of the song. Each skeleton is allowed a Control Resistance. This song affects all skeletons, whether or not they are immune to Hold.

Creates diffuse light with a radius of 1' per Practitioner Title appears around the practitioner for the duration of the song. The light is incapable of blinding, nor does it appear to have a particular source. It illuminates an area 4 times the area affected.

One being of the singer's choice within listening range is protected from being converted into either a physical, spiritual or souled undead creature (the practitioner must choose this beforehand), for 1 minute per Practitioner Title. Any spell, power or effect attempting to raise the target as an undead creature has a 5% chance per Practitioner Title to fail, and a -5% per Practitioner Title to the skill roll.
One listener per Practitioner Title is immune to cold-based touch attacks from undead for the duration of the song.
One listener per Practitioner Title is immune to diseases caused by contact with undead during the duration of the song. Diseases already in effect are unaffected by this song.

Allows the singer to lessen the size of water waves within a radius of 25' per Practitioner Title. The size of affected waves decreases by 10% per Practitioner Title. For example, if a 1st Title Bard is standing on an ocean shore whose waves average 5' high, they can change the size of the waves to be only 4.5' high. The singer can affect water within a range of 50' per Practitioner Title.
Grants the singer and 1 listener per Practitioner Title the ability to walk on cloud and fog as if it were a solid surface.

Allows the singer to create water waves within a radius of 25' per Practitioner Title. The size of affected waves increases by 10% per Practitioner Title. For example, if a 6th Title Bard is standing on an ocean shore whose waves average 21' high, they can change the size of the waves to be 60% higher, or 1'4“ taller, with a total height of 3'4“. The singer can affect water within a range of 50' per Practitioner Title.

Grants the singer and 1 listener per Practitioner Title the ability to walk on extremely hot surfaces (both magical and non-magical), such as burning embers or heated metal, without any adverse effects for the duration of the song. Only the part(s) of the body with which the being uses to walk are affected, and all other fire or heat will affect the targeted listeners as normal.
Causes 1 listener to recall a single forgotten memory of an event that transpired no more than 4 years ago per Practitioner Title.
Causes 1 listener per Practitioner Title to suddenly become replenished and energized, losing 1 level of fatigue per 2 Practitioner Titles.
Causes up to 1 listener per Practitioner Title to make a Control Resistance or instantly fall into a deep sleep for the duration of the song. Has no effect on beings with more than 15 Will Force.

Causes up to 10 cubic feet of snow to melt at a rate of 1 cubic foot per Practitioner Title every 5 minutes. This song can affect both magical and non-magical snow within a range of 10' per Practitioner Title. This song has no effect on ice.

Allows the singer and 1 listener per Practitioner Title to see normally through falling snow. All snowflakes in the affected targets' line of vision appear transparent for the duration of the song. This song does not allow vision through standing snow, such as a snowdrift.

Causes 1 listener to be unable to remove an item from their being for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title. Those unaware or unwilling receive a Magic Resistance. All magical and divine magical items receive a Magic Resistance and artifacts are unaffected.

Allows the singer and 1 listener per Practitioner Title to visualize how a nowruined structure used to look when it was whole, by creating a magical, shimmering outline the color of the singer's aura. This song affects all ruins within a radius of 50' per Practitioner Title.
Unties 2d4 knots within 10' per Practitioner Title. Each targeted knot must have an object strength no greater than 5 points per Practitioner Title.

Allows the singer to communicate with tiny animals, plants and bacteria in an area of water up to 1 cubic foot per Practitioner Title. The singer gains a general sense of what has transpired to these various life forms within the past 24 hours. Since some water moves rapidly (such as rivers and streams) and some moves very slowly (such as ponds), the life forms in the affected area of water could have either remained in that spot for the entire 24 hours or have come from different locations and from far away. Depending on the water source, the knowledge granted to the singer is entirely up to the GM's discretion.

Grants all friendly listeners a +5% bonus per Practitioner Title to the skills Anthropology, Archeology, Direction Knowledge, Explorer, Navigate, Rowing, Ruins Lore and Sail for the duration of the song.
Causes 1 listener per Practitioner Title to suddenly become exhausted, gaining 1 level of fatigue per 2 Practitioner Titles. The targeted being(s) receive a Control Resistance to avoid the effect.

Listeners are placed in a calm, reflective state, possibly gain relief from controlling effects (a new Control Resistance) and for the duration of the song, are granted +5% to informational skills, +15% to Meditate, Body Control and Tranquil Mind (from an upcoming volume.) +10% to Will Force and concentration saves. Any hostile actions taken negate these effects, except for any control that was broken.

Repairs one broken item held by the singer by replacing it with one from an alternate dimension. The item is now supernatural and may be subtly or greatly different than the original at the GM's discretion. If the item (or its dimensional replacement) is magical or divine in nature then this effect only has a 5% chance per practitioner title of succeeding.

While on the plane of dreams the singer can sing into existence one normal dream item of no more than 5 lb. per practitioner title. The item will last 1 hour per practitioner title and has a 2% chance per practitioner title of returning with the dreamer to their plane of origin when they awaken (or leave) the dream plane.

Grants the singer and 1 listener per practitioner title the ability to walk on any liquid as well as immunity to pressure and one other elemental immunity (cold, heat, electricity, acid, life, death, or aura). If on the Plane of Air, the ability to fly at up to 3 feet per Intelligence rating is granted. These effects only operate on the elemental planes and last 1 hour per practitioner title.

Grants one new resistance to any current negative effects caused by a supernatural being for all listeners. If more than one negative effect is in place then one new resistance is granted for each until the total number of negative effects exceeds the singer's practitioner title.
One supernatural being per practitioner title is afforded the opportunity to return to their plane of origin, to their home or other known safe place.
While on the Plane of the Lost/Junk one lost item sung about is returned to the singer, at their feet, at song's end.

A symbol appears above the head of one being per practitioner title. The symbol reveals the plane of origin of the being. The symbol can either be seen only by the practitioner or is revealed to all depending on the singer's desire. Non-detection is proof against this effect. Lasts 1 minute per practitioner title.
Grants the singer and 1 listener per practitioner title freedom from hunger, thirst and the need to breathe as well as granting immunity to pressure and fatigue for 1 hour per practitioner title.
Allows the singer to weave plants into 10 feet of usable rope or 1 square foot of usable cloth per practitioner title. The quality of the material is normal unless craftsperson skills are used.

Allows the practitioner to create a gateway to an alternate plane. It will remain open for 1 minute per practitioner title. It is a two-way gateway while open. Also, anyone passing through gateway gains 1 appropriate protection effect for the plane they are traveling to that lasts 1 hour per practitioner title and can be renewed by the practitioner with a 10 second refrain of the original song. Example: Plane of Fire gateway would provide Endure Heat. If the plane traveled to has no plane-wide dangers, no protections are given. If there is more than one dangerous effect the singer chooses one protection.

Creates a magical jet of acid that flies at one target per 10 seconds. The song can continue and produce a new jet every 10 seconds thereafter but only one jet per Practitioner Title can be created per day. The singer must make an Intelligence save to strike a single target in the area desired. Range is up to 10' per Practitioner Title. Anyone struck by the jet must make a Magic Resistance. Failure indicates 1d10 damage per Practitioner Title in the area struck. Success over 1/2 the Magic Resistance indicates half damage, and success equal to or under 1/2 indicates no damage.
Take the practitioner and up to 1 other ally per Class Title to the tree of life in the center of Balance where rebirth occurs for the neutral, unaligned dead.

Creates a magical jet of chaos that flies at one target per 10 seconds. The song can continue and produce a new jet every 10 seconds thereafter but only one jet per Practitioner Title can be created per day. Failure indicates 1d12 damage per Practitioner Title in the area struck. Success over 1/2 the Magic Resistance indicates half damage, and success equal to or under 1/2 indicates no damage.

Creates a magical ray of frost that flies at one target per 10 seconds. The singer must make an Intelligence save to strike a single target in the area desired. Range is up to 10' per Practitioner Title. Anyone struck by the ray must make a Magic Resistance. Failure indicates 1d4 damage per Practitioner Title in the area struck. Success over 1/2 the Magic Resistance indicates half damage, and success equal to or under 1/2 indicates no damage.
Take the practitioner and up to 1 other ally per Class Title to the Gates of Heaven (outside) or if already in one of the heavenly planes to the inside of Heaven's Gates.
Take the practitioner and up to 1 other ally per Class Title to the Gates of Hell (outside) or if already in one of the hellish planes to the inside of Hell's Gates.

Creates a magical cone of repulsion and sound that flies at one target per 10 seconds. The song can continue and produce a new cone every 10 seconds thereafter.
